description.narrative: (USAID West Africa Regional): Deforestation, forest fragmentation and degradation have an enormous impact on biodiversity and contribute to climate change. One of the biggest challenges in West Africa is the availability and the capacity to produce accurate remote sensing maps to help shape decision making. Remote sensing is a key tool to help stakeholders and decision-makers "see" current and changing landscapes, and better understand drivers of change. Biodiversity must be studied, documented and monitored on the ground at specific sites, but the vastness and complexity of the region calls for a remote sensing approach, coupled with field studies.With FY 2014 funds, the Land Use Dynamics and Adapting to Climate Change in West Africa project will capitalize on a wealth of time-series remote sensing imagery; build upon previous efforts to map and monitor land use and land cover across West Africa including the coastal zone; map biodiversity hotspots, produce one regional atlas of land use land cover change that will serve as springboard for any natural resource management decision making by any stakeholder, build CILSS' capacity to use remote sensing, and mainstream the use of remote sensing maps in planning and decision making in ECOWAS countries.

(USAID Région Afrique de l'Ouest) : L'USAID met en œuvre une variété d'activités de consolidation de la paix et de gouvernance, y compris à la fois des programmes régionaux et des activités bilatérales dans les pays non présents de l'USAID. Cela présente à l’USAID un portefeuille vaste et complexe où la mesure des résultats et de l’impact peut être difficile. Les défis en matière de suivi et d’évaluation sont aggravés par la faible capacité de nombreuses organisations locales à concevoir et mettre en œuvre efficacement la collecte de données sur le terrain. Dans certains cas, un travail de mauvaise qualité a miné ou limité la valeur des plans de suivi et d’évaluation. La nature vaste et variée des activités couvertes par le RPGO présente également des opportunités potentielles d’apprentissage à l’échelle nationale ou inter-programmes/sectoriels qui peuvent être améliorées grâce à une meilleure évaluation. Pour résoudre ces problèmes, le projet de services d’évaluation et d’analyse facilitera une meilleure analyse de l’impact des interventions régionales de consolidation de la paix et de gouvernance grâce à une mesure plus rigoureuse et à une documentation systématique des résultats. Il fournira un outil de gestion pour l'apprentissage à l'échelle nationale, intersectorielle et inter-programmes ainsi que pour les conceptions futures, tout en servant également à améliorer les capacités locales en matière de services d'évaluation. En résumé, l'objectif de cette activité est d'augmenter la disponibilité d'informations de qualité dans la région d'une manière qui puisse soutenir une meilleure réalisation des objectifs de développement et qui puisse être durable après la fin de la période du contrat.

(USAID Région Afrique de l'Ouest) : L'USAID met en œuvre une variété d'activités de consolidation de la paix et de gouvernance, y compris à la fois des programmes régionaux et des activités bilatérales dans les pays non présents de l'USAID. Cela présente à l’USAID un portefeuille vaste et complexe où la mesure des résultats et de l’impact peut être difficile. Les défis en matière de suivi et d’évaluation sont aggravés par la faible capacité de nombreuses organisations locales à concevoir et mettre en œuvre efficacement la collecte de données sur le terrain. Dans certains cas, un travail de mauvaise qualité a miné ou limité la valeur des plans de suivi et d’évaluation. La nature vaste et variée des activités couvertes par le RPGO présente également des opportunités potentielles d’apprentissage à l’échelle nationale ou inter-programmes/sectoriels qui peuvent être améliorées grâce à une meilleure évaluation. Pour résoudre ces problèmes, le projet de services d’évaluation et d’analyse facilitera une meilleure analyse de l’impact des interventions régionales de consolidation de la paix et de gouvernance grâce à une mesure plus rigoureuse et à une documentation systématique des résultats. Il fournira un outil de gestion pour l'apprentissage à l'échelle nationale, intersectorielle et inter-programmes ainsi que pour les conceptions futures, tout en servant également à améliorer les capacités locales en matière de services d'évaluation. En résumé, l'objectif de cette activité est d'augmenter la disponibilité d'informations de qualité dans la région d'une manière qui puisse soutenir une meilleure réalisation des objectifs de développement et qui puisse être durable après la fin de la période du contrat.

(USAID Région Afrique de l'Ouest) : La déforestation, la fragmentation et la dégradation des forêts ont un impact énorme sur la biodiversité et contribuent au changement climatique. L’un des plus grands défis en Afrique de l’Ouest est la disponibilité et la capacité de produire des cartes de télédétection précises pour aider à orienter la prise de décision. La télédétection est un outil clé pour aider les parties prenantes et les décideurs à « voir » les paysages actuels et changeants, et à mieux comprendre les moteurs du changement. La biodiversité doit être étudiée, documentée et surveillée sur le terrain sur des sites spécifiques, mais l'immensité et la complexité de la région nécessitent une approche de télédétection, couplée à des études de terrain. Avec les fonds de l'exercice 2014, le projet Dynamique d'utilisation des terres et adaptation au changement climatique en Afrique de l'Ouest capitalisera sur une richesse d'images de télédétection de séries chronologiques ; s'appuyer sur les efforts antérieurs pour cartographier et surveiller l'utilisation des terres et la couverture terrestre à travers l'Afrique de l'Ouest, y compris la zone côtière ; cartographier les points chauds de la biodiversité, produire un atlas régional des changements d'utilisation des terres qui servira de tremplin à toute prise de décision en matière de gestion des ressources naturelles par toute partie prenante, renforcer la capacité du CILSS à utiliser la télédétection et intégrer l'utilisation des cartes de télédétection dans la planification et la prise de décision dans les pays de la CEDEAO.

Réagir aux données d'alerte précoce et de réponse en Afrique de l'Ouest (REWARD)

description.narrative: (USAID West Africa Regional): .USAID will continue to strengthen ECOWAS's early warning and response capacity by ensuring sustainability in its methodologies, tools, and analytical application processes. Funding will support the implementation of conflict prevention and peacebuilding activities in select ECOWAS member states. FY 2019 activities will include:.. .Improving ECOWAS's early warning and early response systems through capacity building trainings on operationalizing and institutionalizing early warning and conflict prevention frameworks, e.g., Country Risk and Vulnerability Assessment Manual, the Human Security Analysis Framework, the Early Warning Gender Integration Framework and Manual, and the ECOWAS Response Planning Framework.Supporting West African stakeholders to mitigate electoral violence triggers. Through this activity, USAID will provide small grants to locally-led responses, including causes supporting women's and youth participation, awareness raising and peace-messaging campaigns, and training of journalists for responsible reporting on elections. ECOWAS's mandate is to assist member states to enhance peace and security through improved conflict prevention and mitigation. These USAID-funded activities will facilitate non-violent political transitions and advance ECOWAS countries on their journey to self-reliance. Greater stability in West Africa will strengthen American economic opportunities and improve the ability of allies to support American counterterrorism efforts. This activity contributes to JSP Strategic Objectives 1.3 (Counter instability, transnational crime, and violence that threaten U.S. interests by strengthening citizen-responsive governance, security, democracy, human rights, and the rule of law) and 1.2 (Defeat ISIS, al-Qa'ida and other transnational terrorist organizations, and counter state-sponsored, regional, and local terrorist groups that threaten U.S. national security interests).

Prend en charge les coûts indicatifs suivants financés par le programme : les salaires des États-Unis, du FSN et du TCN et d'autres membres du personnel tels que les PSC, les RSSA, les PASA et les CASU travaillant pour le gouvernement américain qui gèrent, administrent et soutiennent les programmes et leurs avantages financés par le programme tels que le logement, les voyages, le transport, les allocations d'études, etc. ; les entrepreneurs institutionnels qui fournissent ce personnel, le loyer, les services informatiques, la part des services publics financée par le programme, les coûts de formation du personnel et les coûts de développement et d'administration des programmes de formation, des équipements et des fournitures, l'ICASS, le carburant et l'entretien des véhicules, les contrats de maintenance, les services de conciergerie, le développement et la maintenance des pages Web des unités opérationnelles, la sensibilisation telle que les publications et le coût de leur préparation (y compris les coûts de personnel), et l'assistance technique pour garantir la conformité du gouvernement américain aux réglementations.

(USAID Région Afrique de l'Ouest) : L'USAID continuera à renforcer la capacité d'alerte précoce et de réponse de la CEDEAO en assurant la durabilité de ses méthodologies, outils et processus d'application analytique. Le financement soutiendra la mise en œuvre d’activités de prévention des conflits et de consolidation de la paix dans certains États membres de la CEDEAO. Les activités de l'exercice 2019 comprendront : . l'amélioration des systèmes d'alerte précoce et de réponse précoce de la CEDEAO à travers des formations de renforcement des capacités sur l'opérationnalisation et l'institutionnalisation des cadres d'alerte précoce et de prévention des conflits, par exemple, le manuel d'évaluation des risques et de la vulnérabilité des pays, le cadre d'analyse de la sécurité humaine, le cadre et manuel d'intégration du genre pour l'alerte précoce et le cadre de planification de la réponse de la CEDEAO. Soutenir les parties prenantes ouest-africaines pour atténuer les déclencheurs de violence électorale. Grâce à cette activité, l'USAID fournira de petites subventions aux réponses menées localement, notamment aux causes soutenant la participation des femmes et des jeunes, aux campagnes de sensibilisation et de messages de paix, et à la formation des journalistes pour un reportage responsable sur les élections. Le mandat de la CEDEAO est d'aider les États membres à renforcer la paix et la sécurité grâce à une meilleure prévention et atténuation des conflits. Ces activités financées par l’USAID faciliteront les transitions politiques non violentes et feront progresser les pays de la CEDEAO sur la voie de l’autonomie. Une plus grande stabilité en Afrique de l’Ouest renforcera les opportunités économiques américaines et améliorera la capacité des alliés à soutenir les efforts américains de lutte contre le terrorisme. description.narrative: (USAID West Africa Regional): .USAID and the U.S. National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) will collaborate with West African countries to provide geospatial data services and strengthen capacity of analysts and decision makers to use geospatial information, including climate information. SERVIR is designed to support USG bilateral investments under the Global Food Security Strategy...FY 2019 activities will include:.Developing demand-driven scalable services using geospatial data in four priority countries cross West Africa, addressing development problems in food security, water and natural resources governance, environmental protection and biodiversity conservation. Working on the Forest Landscape Restoration Opportunities Assessment Methodology (ROAM) in Transboundary Learning Landscapes monitoring platform for illegal artisanal mining and charcoal production. Creating a tool for monitoring deforestation, urbanization and agricultural expansion in Ghana..Characterizing suitable areas for the replication of successful forest regeneration in Niger...Providing institutional support for the Permanent Inter-State Committee for Drought Control in the Sahel/Agrometeorology, Hydrology, and Meteorology Regional Center (CILSS/AGRHYMET). ..USAID and NASA are partnering with AGRHYMET to prepare it to become a regional hub for geospatial technology and analyses and center of excellence on environmental issues, sustainable land and resource management. ..This activity directly addresses JSP Goal 1 by increasing the capacity of governments to address significant challenges and crises such as natural disasters, food insecurity, water scarcity, and land degradation, which can exacerbate political instability and social unrest. It supports participating countries' journey to self-reliance by providing data and data products to national level decision makers for improved policy formulation and resource allocation that contribute to national economic development. .

(USAID Région Afrique de l'Ouest) : L'USAID continuera à renforcer la capacité d'alerte précoce et de réponse de la CEDEAO en assurant la durabilité de ses méthodologies, outils et processus d'application analytique. (USAID Région Afrique de l'Ouest) : L'USAID et l'Administration nationale de l'aéronautique et de l'espace (NASA) des États-Unis collaboreront avec les pays d'Afrique de l'Ouest pour fournir des services de données géospatiales et renforcer la capacité des analystes et des décideurs à utiliser les informations géospatiales, y compris les informations climatiques. SERVIR est conçu pour soutenir les investissements bilatéraux du gouvernement américain dans le cadre de la Stratégie mondiale de sécurité alimentaire... Les activités de l'exercice 2019 comprendront : Le développement de services évolutifs axés sur la demande et utilisant des données géospatiales dans quatre pays prioritaires d'Afrique de l'Ouest, abordant les problèmes de développement en matière de sécurité alimentaire, de gouvernance de l'eau et des ressources naturelles, de protection de l'environnement et de conservation de la biodiversité. Travailler sur la méthodologie d'évaluation des opportunités de restauration des paysages forestiers (ROAM) dans la plateforme de surveillance des paysages d'apprentissage transfrontaliers pour l'exploitation minière artisanale illégale et la production de charbon de bois. Création d'un outil de suivi de la déforestation, de l'urbanisation et de l'expansion agricole au Ghana. Caractérisation des zones appropriées pour la réplication d'une régénération forestière réussie au Niger. Appui institutionnel au Comité permanent inter-États de lutte contre la sécheresse au Sahel/Centre régional d'agrométéorologie, d'hydrologie et de météorologie (CILSS/AGRHYMET). ..L'USAID et la NASA s'associent à AGRHYMET pour le préparer à devenir un pôle régional de technologie et d'analyses géospatiales et un centre d'excellence sur les questions environnementales, la gestion durable des terres et des ressources. ..Cette activité répond directement à l'objectif 1 du JSP en augmentant la capacité des gouvernements à relever des défis et des crises importants tels que les catastrophes naturelles, l'insécurité alimentaire, la pénurie d'eau et la dégradation des terres, qui peuvent exacerber l'instabilité politique et les troubles sociaux. Il soutient le parcours des pays participants vers l'autonomie en fournissant des données et des produits de données aux décideurs au niveau national pour améliorer la formulation des politiques et l'allocation des ressources qui contribuent au développement économique national. .

Il soutient le parcours des pays participants vers l'autonomie en fournissant des données et des produits de données aux décideurs au niveau national pour améliorer la formulation des politiques et l'allocation des ressources qui contribuent au développement économique national. .

(USAID West Africa Regional): USAID will continue to strengthen the capacity of West African national governments, civil society actors, and regional institutions to address countering violent extremism (CVE) needs as part of USAID's broader CVE efforts in the Sahel. FY 2019 activities will include:Strengthening the capacity of national governments and regional institutions to develop CVE strategies in collaboration with key G5 Sahel stakeholders and member states.Advancing civil society organizations' understanding of the root causes of vulnerability to violent extremism (VE), and developing programs that serve at-risk communities.Improving coordination on CVE approaches across government entities and among traditional and religious leaders, youth, and women's groups..Partnerships for Peace (P4P) advances countries on their journey to self-reliance by building the capacity of West African governments and regional institutions to address the rapid spread of VE and to implement their CVE approaches. P4P builds the commitment of regional and national institutions to address development challenges effectively, inclusively, and with accountability..This activity defends U.S. national security by strengthening the capacity of government and civil society allies to prevent the expansion of violent extremist groups in West Africa. P4P contributes directly to JSP Strategic Objectives 3.3 (Increase partnerships with the private sector and civil-society organizations to mobilize support and resources and shape foreign public opinion) and 1.2 (Defeat ISIS, al-Qa'ida and other transnational terrorist organizations, and counter state-sponsored, regional, and local terrorist groups that threaten U.S. national security interests) by empowering national governments, civil society, and regional institutions to address violent extremism threats and communities needs.

Objectives for South of Sahara, regional: Partnerships for Peace will improve West Africans’ capacity to counter violent extremism by achieving the following results: Greater understanding of violent extremism and knowledge of CVE approaches in West Africa. Increased leadership of CVE efforts by West African governments and civil society. Improved regional coordination of CVE efforts

description.narrative: (USAID Sahel Regional Program): USAID's Resilience and Economic Growth in the Sahel - Enhanced Resilience (REGIS-ER) activity increases the resilience of chronically vulnerable communities in Niger and Burkina Faso by implementing a multi-sectoral resilience program to address the root causes of chronic vulnerability to shocks and stresses. USAID integrates sustainable livelihoods, natural resource management, governance, and health and nutrition activities in collaboration with local communities. In November 2017, USAID granted REGIS-ER an extension to ensure the sustainability and ownership of the project's activities by local entities in eight select target communes in Burkina Faso and Niger. .REGIS-ER promotes good health and nutrition practices for pregnant women, breastfeeding women, and children under 5 years of age, reaching more than 62,000 children under 5 and more than 4,400 pregnant women. These programs emphasize proper nutrition for mother and child, immunizations, and utilization of local health clinics for prenatal, postnatal, and postpartum care. REGIS-ER focuses on establishing and supporting mother-to-mother peer groups, and strengthening village health workers that facilitate provision of health services to mothers and infants..With FY 2018 funds, USAID will focus on building the capacity of local governance entities to enhance service delivery of key activities to include mother to mother care groups, market and home garden management, conservation farming and farmer-managed natural regeneration. By the end of the extension, local government, civil society, and service providers in the eight target communes will have acquired the institutional, organizational, and individual capacities to autonomously carry forward resilience-related activities and successful best practices introduced by the activity. .... .. .. .

(USAID Région Afrique de l'Ouest) : L'USAID et l'Administration nationale de l'aéronautique et de l'espace (NASA) des États-Unis collaboreront avec les pays d'Afrique de l'Ouest pour fournir des services de données géospatiales et renforcer la capacité des analystes et des décideurs à utiliser les informations géospatiales, y compris les informations climatiques. (Programme régional de l'USAID Sahel) : L'activité Résilience et croissance économique au Sahel - Résilience renforcée (REGIS-ER) de l'USAID augmente la résilience des communautés chroniquement vulnérables au Niger et au Burkina Faso en mettant en œuvre un programme de résilience multisectoriel pour s'attaquer aux causes profondes de la vulnérabilité chronique aux chocs et aux stress. L'USAID intègre des activités de subsistance durables, de gestion des ressources naturelles, de gouvernance, de santé et de nutrition en collaboration avec les communautés locales. En novembre 2017, l'USAID a accordé à REGIS-ER une prolongation pour garantir la durabilité et l'appropriation des activités du projet par les entités locales dans huit communes cibles sélectionnées au Burkina Faso et au Niger. .REGIS-ER promeut les bonnes pratiques de santé et de nutrition auprès des femmes enceintes, des femmes allaitantes et des enfants de moins de 5 ans, touchant plus de 62 000 enfants de moins de 5 ans et plus de 4 400 femmes enceintes. Ces programmes mettent l'accent sur une bonne nutrition de la mère et de l'enfant, sur la vaccination et sur l'utilisation des cliniques de santé locales pour les soins prénatals, postnatals et post-partum. REGIS-ER se concentre sur la création et le soutien de groupes de pairs de mère à mère et sur le renforcement des agents de santé villageois qui facilitent la fourniture de services de santé aux mères et aux nourrissons. Avec les fonds de l'exercice 2018, l'USAID se concentrera sur le renforcement des capacités des entités de gouvernance locale pour améliorer la prestation de services d'activités clés pour inclure les groupes de soins de mère à mère, la gestion des marchés et des jardins familiaux, l'agriculture de conservation et la régénération naturelle gérée par les agriculteurs. À la fin de l'extension, les autorités locales, la société civile et les prestataires de services des huit communes cibles auront acquis les capacités institutionnelles, organisationnelles et individuelles nécessaires pour mener de manière autonome les activités liées à la résilience et les meilleures pratiques réussies introduites par l'activité. .... .. .. .

description.narrative: The purpose of the Global Development Partnership is to establish an alliance between USAID, LWR, Airtel, Ecobank, S.H. Biaugeaud and Margaret A. description.narrative: REGIS-AG increases the resilience of chronically vulnerable communities in targeted zones of Niger and Burkina Faso. It focuses on strengthening the cowpea, small ruminant and poultry value chains in agro-pastoralist and marginal agricultural zones. REGIS-AG uses innovative "pull" strategies linking smallholder groups and associations to cash markets, in cooperation with others development programs, which focus on production level "push" strategies, in order to move vulnerable households from subsistence to food security.

Cargill (ci-après chacun un « Participant » et collectivement « les Participants ») pour promouvoir les objectifs énoncés ci-dessous et pour décrire les compréhensions et les intentions concernant ces objectifs communs. REGIS-AG augmente la résilience des communautés chroniquement vulnérables dans les zones ciblées du Niger et du Burkina Faso. Il se concentre sur le renforcement des chaînes de valeur du niébé, des petits ruminants et de la volaille dans les zones agro-pastorales et agricoles marginales. REGIS-AG utilise des stratégies « d'attraction » innovantes reliant les groupes et associations de petits exploitants aux marchés monétaires, en coopération avec d'autres programmes de développement, qui se concentrent sur des stratégies de « poussée » au niveau de la production, afin de faire passer les ménages vulnérables de la subsistance à la sécurité alimentaire.

(USAID Sahel Regional Program): USAID's Sahel Resilience Learning Project (SAREL) contract works to strengthen the capacity of key stakeholders to engage in adaptive, evidence-based learning in order to promote the adoption of methods and innovations that best enhance resilience in the region. USAID's SAREL accomplishes this through the following objectives:-Test, expand and accelerate the adoption of proven resilience-enhancing technologies and innovations;-Develop, test, and promote widespread adoption of new models that integrate humanitarian and development assistance;-Promote ownership, build the capacity of national and regional institutions, and coordinate humanitarian and development interventions;-Address gender issues key to resilience and growth; and-Create a knowledge management database.SAREL carries out quantitative evaluations and promotes learning between IPs and local governments on a variety of topics including all aspects of health - maternal and child health, family planning, nutrition and WASH. More specifically, SAREL carries out data quality assessments for health indicators in maternal and child health, family planning, nutrition, WASH, and other sectors. SAREL organizes collaboration and communication workshops that bring partners together on topics in various sectors including health to promote the sharing of best practices with the goal of improving overall results..In its last year of implementation, SAREL will look to consolidating knowledge gains among RISE partners and transfer this knowledge to Government partners in Niger and Burkina Faso to fulfill their resilience leadership role. This will be done through the establishment of a collaboration, learning, and adaptation guide; the organization of coaching sessions for government staff; and technical assistance in organizing collaboration and coordination workshops. ... .. .. .

REGIS-AG augmente la résilience des communautés chroniquement vulnérables dans les zones ciblées du Niger et du Burkina Faso. Il se concentre sur le renforcement des chaînes de valeur du niébé, des petits ruminants et de la volaille dans les zones agro-pastorales et agricoles marginales. REGIS-AG utilise des stratégies « d'attraction » innovantes reliant les groupes et associations de petits exploitants aux marchés monétaires, en coopération avec d'autres programmes de développement, qui se concentrent sur des stratégies de « poussée » au niveau de la production, afin de faire passer les ménages vulnérables de la subsistance à la sécurité alimentaire.

(Programme régional de l'USAID Sahel) : le contrat du Projet d'apprentissage sur la résilience au Sahel (SAREL) de l'USAID vise à renforcer la capacité des principales parties prenantes à s'engager dans un apprentissage adaptatif et fondé sur des données probantes afin de promouvoir l'adoption de méthodes et d'innovations qui améliorent au mieux la résilience dans la région. Le SAREL de l'USAID y parvient à travers les objectifs suivants : - Tester, étendre et accélérer l'adoption de technologies et d'innovations éprouvées améliorant la résilience ; - Développer, tester et promouvoir l'adoption généralisée de nouveaux modèles qui intègrent l'aide humanitaire et l'aide au développement ; et-Créer une base de données de gestion des connaissances. SAREL effectue des évaluations quantitatives et favorise l'apprentissage entre les PA et les gouvernements locaux sur une variété de sujets, y compris tous les aspects de la santé - santé maternelle et infantile, planification familiale, nutrition et WASH. Plus spécifiquement, SAREL effectue des évaluations de la qualité des données pour les indicateurs de santé dans les domaines de la santé maternelle et infantile, de la planification familiale, de la nutrition, de WASH et d'autres secteurs. SAREL organise des ateliers de collaboration et de communication qui rassemblent des partenaires sur des sujets dans divers secteurs, dont la santé, pour promouvoir le partage des meilleures pratiques dans le but d'améliorer les résultats globaux. Au cours de sa dernière année de mise en œuvre, SAREL cherchera à consolider les acquis des connaissances parmi les partenaires de RISE et à transférer ces connaissances aux partenaires gouvernementaux du Niger et du Burkina Faso pour remplir leur rôle de leadership en matière de résilience. Cela se fera à travers la mise en place d’un guide de collaboration, d’apprentissage et d’adaptation ; l'organisation de séances de coaching pour les agents de l'État ; et une assistance technique pour l’organisation d’ateliers de collaboration et de coordination. ... .. .. .

description.narrative: The purpose of the overarching Participatory, Responsive Governance (PRG) Project is to improve collective (government and citizen) responsiveness to priority public needs. PRG Principal Activity (PRG-PA) will increase the capacity of stakeholders - including CSOs, traditional and religious leaders, government representatives and political parties, and the media and private sectors - to identify the local dynamics that block or promote reform (research) and to apply this learning to mobilize around collective action. PRG-PA will work with stakeholders to examine these local dynamics, systems and incentives together (dialogue) and enact measure (action) that encourage government stakeholders to work with civil society and the media toward initiatives that benefit Nigerien society as a whole.

Favoriser l'objectif consistant à aider le Burkina Faso à organiser des élections démocratiques bien gérées qui répondent aux besoins de la population et développent une société forte à l'esprit civique.

L’objectif du projet global de gouvernance participative et réactive (PRG) est d’améliorer la réactivité collective (gouvernement et citoyen) aux besoins publics prioritaires. L'activité principale du PRG (PRG-PA) augmentera la capacité des parties prenantes - y compris les OSC, les chefs traditionnels et religieux, les représentants du gouvernement et les partis politiques, ainsi que les médias et les secteurs privés - à identifier les dynamiques locales qui bloquent ou promeuvent la réforme (recherche) et à appliquer cet apprentissage pour se mobiliser autour d'une action collective. PRG-PA travaillera avec les parties prenantes pour examiner ensemble ces dynamiques, systèmes et incitations locales (dialogue) et adopter des mesures (action) qui encouragent les parties prenantes gouvernementales à travailler avec la société civile et les médias pour des initiatives qui profitent à la société nigérienne dans son ensemble.

description.narrative: The overall goal of the TA program is to strengthen the South Sudan MoEST at the central, state and county level to deliver education programs and services and, increase sustainability of USAIDs investments in education. Although the MoEST has made great progress in the initial stages of this process, much remains to be done. Enrolment rates are still unacceptably low, particularly in the rural and remote areas that represent the majority of South Sudan. If the system is to meet the ambitious goals for rapid expansion over the next five years, large numbers of teachers will have to be prepared and supported, using innovative and fast-track approaches. Systems of management must be put in place to ensure that funds flow in an efficient and accountable manner, including payments for teachers. The state ministries and the county education offices will play a vital role in an expanding and decentralized education system, however, they will need strong support and guidance from the central MoEST. The EQUIP2 mechanism is well placed to play a critical role in supporting MoESTs growing capacity to lead an effective and rapidly expanding education system.

description.narrative: (Mozambique): .The Supporting the Policy Environment for Economic.Development (SPEED+) activity promotes an improved enabling environment to.attract investment, expand markets, and reduce costs for businesses,.contributing to the Mission Objective of inclusive economic growth while.conserving natural resources. SPEED+ provides capacity-building to the.government, private sector, and civil society to improve public-private.dialogue, strengthen the implementation of government policies and regulations,.and to support structural policy reforms across: (1) agriculture and nutrition,.(2) trade and business enabling environment, (3) power and water, and (4).biodiversity conservation. In agriculture, SPEED+ promotes an improved land.policy framework, backs government efforts to update laws governing key.agriculture sectors, promotes rural trade, and supports an improved nutrition.policy. SPEED+ helps Mozambique improve its 'Doing Business' indicators,.including efforts to update legislation, such as the Labor Law. The program.promotes implementation of the Trade Facilitation Agreement and the AGOA.Utilization Strategy. SPEED+ supports improved trade policies and government.capacities to improve competitiveness of trade corridors. SPEED+ strengthens.the legal framework and government's regulatory capacity for power generation.and distribution in tandem with improving the enabling environment for.Independent Power Producers. The program develops tools to strengthen the.licensing, monitoring, and capacity of private water systems, and stimulate.private investment in water and sanitation. SPEED+ works with government,.private sector, and civil society to strengthen biodiversity conservation.policies, provide institutional support to the National Administration of.Conservation Areas, and support effective co-management and governance of.conservation areas... .

(Moçambique): .A actividade de Apoio ao Ambiente Político para o Desenvolvimento Económico (SPEED+) promove um ambiente favorável melhorado para.atrair investimento, expandir mercados e reduzir custos para as empresas,.contribuindo para o Objectivo da Missão de crescimento económico inclusivo e, ao mesmo tempo, conservando os recursos naturais. O SPEED+ fornece capacitação ao governo, ao sector privado e à sociedade civil para melhorar o diálogo público-privado, fortalecer a implementação de políticas e regulamentos governamentais e para apoiar reformas políticas estruturais em: (1) agricultura e nutrição, (2) ambiente propício ao comércio e negócios, (3) energia e água, e (4) conservação da biodiversidade. Na agricultura, o SPEED+ promove um quadro melhorado de política fundiária, apoia os esforços do governo para actualizar as leis que regem os principais sectores agrícolas, promove o comércio rural e apoia uma política nutricional melhorada. O SPEED+ ajuda Moçambique a melhorar os seus indicadores de 'Doing Business', incluindo esforços para actualizar a legislação, como a Lei do Trabalho. O programa promove a implementação do Acordo de Facilitação do Comércio e da Estratégia de Utilização da AGOA. O SPEED+ apoia políticas comerciais melhoradas e capacidades governamentais para melhorar a competitividade dos corredores comerciais. O SPEED+ fortalece o quadro jurídico e a capacidade reguladora do governo para a geração e distribuição de energia, em conjunto com a melhoria do ambiente propício para os Produtores Independentes de Energia. O programa desenvolve ferramentas para reforçar o licenciamento, a monitorização e a capacidade dos sistemas privados de água e estimular o investimento privado na água e no saneamento. O SPEED+ trabalha com o governo, o sector privado e a sociedade civil para fortalecer as políticas de conservação da biodiversidade, fornecer apoio institucional à Administração Nacional das Áreas de Conservação e apoiar a co-gestão e governação eficazes das áreas de conservação... .

description.narrative: (USAID Central Africa Regional): USAID's Forest Resource Management activity will provide technical assistance to national governments, regional institutions, and civil society actors in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Republic of the Congo, Cameroon, Gabon, Central African Republic, and potentially other countries in the region. The objectives are to scale up and institutionalize land-use planning and strengthen community forest management and livelihoods, forest monitoring, and institutional capacity at regional, national, provincial and local levels. This activity will a) develop robust and transparent land use and forest management policies, regulatory frameworks, and planning processes as the bedrock of sustainable forest management; b) improve access to and use of data, tools and advanced technologies for forest policy and management; c) advance dynamic forest economies supporting expanded community-based forest management; and d) strengthen institutional capacity for sustainable forest management at regional, national and local government levels...The activity will maintain the ecological integrity of the humid forest ecosystem of the Congo Basin, which is vital to regional stability, a U.S. foreign policy priority in Central Africa. It contributes to the Joint Strategic Plan Strategic Objective 2.2: (Promote healthy, educated and productive populations in partner countries to drive inclusive and sustainable development, open new markets and support U.S. prosperity and security objectives) by protecting natural resources critical to long term, sustainable growth, and food and water security. Furthermore, the activity will build the capacity of regional governments to meet their Nationally Determined Contributions for the Paris Climate Agreement and to access global climate funding mechanisms such as the Green Climate Fund (GCF) and the Central African Forest Initiative (CAFI).... .

description.narrative: (Ethiopia): .USAID's Building the Potential of Youth (POTENTIAL) provides access to workforce development and livelihood support, which is tailored to youth's specific needs and local market demands. With 70 percent of Ethiopia's population under the age of 30, the youth are disproportionately affected by poverty, conflict, and violence. A core grievance is high youth unemployment, which is a combination of the GOE's inability to create enough jobs and a lack of access to resources. As a stability exporter to the rest of the region, the GOE and the U.S. have recognized the threat that is posed by these youth to Ethiopia's overall stability. By staying attuned to this critical demographic, the U.S. is accelerating Ethiopia's economic journey, while also maintaining broader stability in the Horn of Africa - an American foreign policy objective. ..With FY 2019 funds, POTENTIAL and a future follow-on award, will enable unemployed and underemployed youth aged 15-29, mainly in rural areas, to gain better access to employability knowledge and workforce skills to achieve economic self-sufficiency over the longer term. Specifically, POTENTIAL will target U.S and Ethiopian higher education partnerships to build the capacity of 30 Technical Vocational Education and Training Colleges (TVET). Key activities will include strengthening career guidance and transitions to the labor market and connecting underserved youth, especially women, to employment and income opportunities. FY 2019 funds will also provide the youth with transferable life skills training, linkages with microfinance institutions, and Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) training in rural youth centers to support gainful employment. ... .... .. .

description.narrative: The African Union Partnership (AUP) program managed by FHI 360 provides technical assistance to the African Union Commission (AUC) to strengthen economic empowerment in Africa. AUP interventions focus on four closely related areas: workforce and skills development; economic growth and empowerment; trade and market facilitation; and AUC institutional capacity building. The AUP has helped the African Union (AU) to improve their Youth Volunteer Corps program by providing technical assistance to youth volunteer orientation and training programs; supported a competition for continental models for Technical and Vocational Education and Training; provided research data on regional trade integration to help the AU determine where gaps are in continental trade strategies in the lead up to the adoption of the African Continental Free Trade Agreement; and supported the AU Strategic Planning and Deputy Chairperson's offices in the design and implementation of resource mobilization strategies.

title.narrative: Rapid and Effective Action Combating HIV/AIDS (REACH)

description.narrative: In April 2005, Pact entered into a Cooperative Agreement with USAID South Africas Regional HIV & AIDS Program for Southern Africa (RHAP) to provide grants to local and international organizations implementing HIV & AIDS interventions (Sexual Prevention, Care and Support, Counseling and Testing, Male Circumcision, and OVC) of the Presidents Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief (PEPFAR) in Swaziland. The five-year program was designed to facilitate the efficient flow of grant funds and to deliver capacity building services to organizations contributing to the fight against HIV & AIDS. In March 2010, Pact was awarded a new five year Cooperative Agreement to continue with the activities under the previous agreement as well as to implement new activities. New activities include providing support to local Umbrella Grants Management (UGM) partner and strengthening civil society organizations to implement and leverage resources from Global Fund. The overall goal sought is to reduce the impact of HIV & AIDS and improve health care for Swazis by developing a strengthened, national level, coordinated civil society response to HIV & AIDS in Swaziland. Specefic objectives include: (1) To strengthen 1-2 local NGOs in umbrella grants management thereby enabling them to manage and sub-award funding from PEPFAR, Global Fund, and other major donors in Swaziland. (2) To provide PEPFAR funding and minimal technical assistance to 3-5 mature NGOs to enable them to deliver reliable and quality HIV & AIDS services to the community. (3) To provide PEPFAR funding and full package of technical assistance to 10-15 nascent NGOs CBOs/FBOs to enable them to deliver reliable and quality HIV & AIDS services to the community. (4) To train, mentor, and provide and/or link Global Fund civil society recipients to appropriate technical assistance.

title.narrative: Palliative Care for People Living with HIV/AIDS

description.narrative: (USAID Southern Africa Regional): This project will ensure that palliative care is underpinned by evidence, widely understood and integrated into all health systems in order to reduce pain and suffering associated with life- limiting and chronic illnesses. This follow-on award will build on the last 5 years of activities which built capacity for palliative care delivery through partnerships with local Ministries of Health (MOH) and national and community based organizations (CBOs) in focus countries. The partner will strengthen those aspects of care and support which retain PLHIV in care, positive living and prevention and develop the capacity of health systems to address emerging needs and priorities related to chronic care, including drug adherence, the long term effects of anti-retroviral treatment and the psycho-social issues that may arise especially among adolescent and young people, working closely with the MOH, other local stakeholders, and CBOs to ensure capacity development and future sustainability.

title.narrative: Building Local Capacity (BLC) for Delivery of HIV Services in Southern Africa

description.narrative: (USAID Southern Africa Regional): High background HIV prevalence, along with an unacceptably high rate of new infections, has widespread effects which undermine the ability of all sectors to attain their development objectives in the region. To promote a holistic provision of care, MSH will identify opportunities to integrate treatment and care services into the prevention programs currently being provided to migrants. Key in this activity is close collaboration and related systems strengthening which will enable the HIV Unit in the Southern African Development Community (SADC) to effectively implement its Global Fund grant for addressing HIV in migrant populations. Underpinning all activities is the BLC project's focus on health systems strengthening (HSS) and building capacity of local regional partners. As a key milestone, the BLC project has the target of graduating ten local partners to become direct recipients of USG funds by the end of the project.

title.narrative: Reducing Infection through Support and Education (RISE) - PMTCT
Redução da Infecção através do Apoio e da Educação (RISE) - PTV

description.narrative: (USAID Southern Africa Regional): .Mothers2mothers (m2m) is an indigenous organization operating across the Southern Africa region that empowers women to empower their communities to apply African solutions that have proven to be effective in reducing HIV transmission. The m2m Mentor Mother model overcomes some of the barriers to rolling out Prevention of Mother To Child Transmission (PMTCT) by employing local HIV positive mothers who have already gone through a PMTCT program and serve as role models and peer counselors. The RISE project will work in Southern Africa to:.Provide quality PMTCT education and support services through a direct service delivery approach;Expand its core psycho-social support and education services to encompass comprehensive maternal and child health care and to provide services to both HIV-positive and HIV-negative women and their families at the facility and community levels; andProvide early childhood education integrated services at facilities and in communities.

(USAID Southern Africa Regional): .Mothers2mothers (m2m) é uma organização indígena que opera em toda a região da África Austral que capacita as mulheres a capacitar as suas comunidades para aplicar soluções africanas que provaram ser eficazes na redução da transmissão do VIH. O modelo m2m Mãe Mentora supera algumas das barreiras à implementação da Prevenção da Transmissão Vertical de Mãe para Filho (PTV), empregando mães seropositivas locais que já passaram por um programa de PTV e servem como modelos e conselheiras de pares. O projecto RISE trabalhará na África Austral para: Fornecer educação de qualidade e serviços de apoio à PTV através de uma abordagem de prestação de serviços directa; Expandir os seus principais serviços de apoio psicossocial e educação para abranger cuidados de saúde materna e infantil abrangentes e para fornecer serviços a mulheres seropositivas e seronegativas e às suas famílias, a nível das unidades sanitárias e da comunidade; e Fornecer serviços integrados de educação infantil em instalações e comunidades.

title.narrative: Capacity Development Support (CDS): Follow On Project

description.narrative: The purpose of this award is to assist the South African Government (SAG) and civil society organizations (CSOs) to sustain an improved, expanded, and country-led response to HIV and AIDS.

Assist special populations which may be vulnerable or at-risk on a temporary or chronic basis whose needs are not addressed under emergency humanitarian assistance or other programs. These include groups such as the disabled; orphans, children and at-risk youth; victims of trafficking; victims of gender-based violence; refugees, returnees, ethnic minorities, internally displaced or other socially excluded groups; the elderly; and female heads of household. Depending on circumstances, services may intend to protect groups; mitigate adverse conditions they face, or to remove barriers to help integrate them into society. Components may include measures to increase the capacity of local service and advocacy NGOs and/or professional social workers; to establish public/private service delivery partnerships as well as family and community focused service models; to establish effective referral networks; to develop appropriate service protocols and methods for screening prospective recipients; or to improve public understanding and sensitivity to the needs of the vulnerable. While services provided should not exclude victims of trafficking in persons, programs designed specifically for this group fall under the Peace and Security Objective under the Transnational Crime Area and the Trafficking in Persons and Migrant Smuggling Element.

title.narrative: Voluntary Medical Male Circumcision (VMMC), Early Infant Male Circumcision (EIMC) and Pre-Service Education in Lesotho

description.narrative: The overall goal of this new project is to strengthen the Government of Lesotho's (GOL) capacity to respond to national priorities in health and HIV/AIDS and contribute to the national target of reducing the number of new HIV infections. It will achieve this through four project objectives, namely; 1) Scale-up quality of VMMC and EIMC services provided by the Ministry of Health; 2) Increase use of VMMC and EIMC services and post-procedure protective behaviors; 3) Strengthen Basotho nursing system capacity to respond to priorities in health and HIV/AIDS; and 4) Ensure long-term increases in medical male circumcision prevalence and quality education through increasingly sustainable VMMC and EIMC services and pre-service education.

title.narrative: Young African Leaders Initiative (YALI) Regional Leadership Centre Southern Africa

description.narrative: The Young African Leaders Initiative (YALI) was launched by President of the United States Barack Obama as a signature effort to invest in the next generation of African leaders. The conceptualisation, development and curriculum content of the Regional Leadership Center Southern Africa (RLC SA) as led by the University of South Africa (Unisa) were heavily influenced by the developmental, political and economic dynamics of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) region. The RLC SA will develop the young African leaders in Business and Entrepreneurship Development; Civic Leadership; and Public Management and Governance through a hybrid of innovative and complimentary approaches that include contact sessions; online mentoring; online self-paced tuition; industry placements and experiential learning. The centre will have year-long access to the state-of-the-art facilities at the Unisa School of Business Leadership in Midrand, South Africa for the English speaking participants. The same program will be replicated in Mozambique for Portuguese speaking participants as a way of reaching and opening access to the disadvantaged lusophone communities. Contemporary African issues such as HIV/AIDS, gender, responsible leadership and technology will also be infused into the program to develop young and transformative African leaders. The productive partnership with the local and USA universities; private sector partners as well as the regional bodies such as SADC and the African Union will contribute to the improved quality of the program as well as the access, reach and delivery mechanisms.

title.narrative: Combatting Wildlife Crime in Malawi - Zambia Transboundary Landscape

description.narrative: USAID will invest in this mechanism to advance U.S. Government priorities for combating wildlife trafficking. The implementer is collaborating with government counterparts and non-governmental organizations to reduce illegal wildlife trade and poaching, and to improve wildlife management in the Malawi-Zambia trans-boundary landscape.The program, which will complement planned INL CWT interdiction investments, will strengthen the capabilities of Malawi's interagency task force on wildlife crime; support the completion of regulations to enforce the new National Parks and Wildlife Act; develop appropriate education and communication materials to improve awareness on poaching and illicit wildlife trade issues; and develop and implement appropriate community engagement strategies to combat poaching and wildlife crime in targeted communities.

title.narrative: Southern Africa Regional Environmental Program (SAREP) Extension

description.narrative: (USAID Southern Africa Regional): SAREP is a five-year contract scheduled to end in June 2015. The Mission intends to extend the contract for one year, using $3.4 million in FY 2015 funds (22 percent of which is attributable to climate change; 20 percent attributable to biodiversity; and 58 percent attributable to water supply and sanitation earmarks). SAREP will continue to strengthen capacity for integrated river basin management and climate change adaptation across Angola, Botswana and Namibia. The scope of work for the one-year extension is currently under development but will achieve the following primary objectives: -decreased threats to biodiversity conservation within transboundary management areas; -increased capacity within natural resource management agencies; improved coordination among government agencies within the basin for biodiversity conservation; and increased capacity to adapt the effects of climate change for targeted communities.

description.narrative: (USAID Southern Africa Regional): This mechanism will increase intra-regional trade with a focus on agricultural products and improve food security by improving the competitiveness of commodity value chains, leveraging South African capital and advanced agricultural technology, and promoting better management practices and improved infrastructure. Support will also be provided to improve the agricultural enabling environment with a specific focus on reducing the time and cost of trading across borders. This will be done by deploying proven trade facilitation tools and measures such as customs connectivity, national single windows, World Trade Organization (WTO) enquiry points, and trade repositories in Feed the Future focus and aligned countries as well as their key trading partners. Support will also be given to improve trade, investment and economic integration through harmonized technical and sanitary & phytosanitary standards to comply with countries' WTO commitments.

title.narrative: Resiliency in the Limpopo River Basin (RESILIM)

description.narrative: (USAID Southern Africa Regional): Resilience in the Limpopo Basin (RESILIM) project seeks to improve transboundary water and natural resource management for improved resilience of communities and ecosystems. FY14 funding will build upon risk and vulnerability mapping and hotspot analysis through implementing pilot activities in areas vulnerable to climate change. RESILIM will enhance institutional capacity around resilience building and conserving biodiversity through grants/subcontracts and will continue to foster dialogue among key institutions and decision makers to incorporate these issues into policy making. RESILIM will begin implementing the knowledge management and communication plan ensuring access to information to support related sound decision making. At least 2,000 people will have increased capacity to address climate change impacts and 3,500 ha in biologically significant areas will demonstrate improved biophysical conditions as a result of USAID's assistance.

title.narrative: Power Africa: Southern Africa Energy Program (SAEP)

description.narrative: (USAID Africa Regional): The Southern Africa Energy Program (SAEP) seeks to increase electricity availability and access in Southern Africa by facilitating transactions for generation, transmission, distribution, and off-grid access projects. This activity will advance development priorities including inclusive economic growth, security, and improved health and education outcomes. The program will stimulate private sector investment in the power sector by addressing key constraints related to; 1) regulation, policy, and planning to build the enabling environment for expanded access to electricity, 2) commercial viability of electric utilities, 3) regional integration and power trading, 4) scaling up renewable energy and energy efficiency, and 5) human and institutional capacity building..SAEP works to contribute to Power Africa's continent-wide goals of increasing new power generation by 30,000 MW and increasing new connections by 60 million by 2030. Over its five-year life, SAEP is designed to meet program-specific goals to increase electricity supply and access, and will deliver:.3,000 MW of new power generation1,000 MW of new transmission capacity3 million new connectionsFY 2021 funds will be used for SAEP activities that provide technical assistance, primarily training and advice to utilities and government energy agencies on technical, regulatory and policy issues; transaction advisory services to private sector energy project developers; and sharing of knowledge across the region in technical reports and webinars..SAEP will advance democratic governance and rule of law to counter PRC influence by working with key partners to strengthen governance and advance inclusive development. Efforts include collaborating with partners in strengthening the resilience of energy sector institutions, and promoting access to information..SAEP currently provides support in Angola, Botswana, Zambia, Namibia, Malawi, Mozambique, Madagascar, South Africa, Lesotho, and Eswatini..

title.narrative: Processus de paix et de réconciliation
Processus de paix et de réconciliation

description.narrative: Support and strengthen the negotiation process and implement peace and reconciliation processes, accords and ceasefire agreements at track levels 1, 2 and 3, including support to indigenous peacebuilding efforts. For a peace/negotiations process to have a chance of success, it must entail building trust in the process, between parties, and among their constituents, with a special focus on including women. Illustrative activities include negotiation training; platform development; public opinion polling; facilitation activities; elder statesmen engagement; provision of international expert advice and knowledge; financial support to parties; multi-stakeholder dialogues; assistance with the design of peacebuilding training programs; support and maintenance of agreed verification mechanisms; support to complaint tracking mechanisms; and work with local and national government representatives to bring them closer to their constituencies.

Soutenir et renforcer le processus de négociation et mettre en œuvre des processus de paix et de réconciliation, des accords et des accords de cessez-le-feu aux niveaux 1, 2 et 3, y compris le soutien aux efforts autochtones de consolidation de la paix. Pour qu’un processus de paix/négociations ait une chance de succès, il doit impliquer d’instaurer la confiance dans le processus, entre les parties et parmi leurs constituants, en mettant particulièrement l’accent sur l’inclusion des femmes. Les activités illustratives comprennent la formation à la négociation ; développement de plates-formes ; sondages d'opinion publique; activités d'animation ; l’engagement des hommes d’État plus âgés ; fourniture de conseils et de connaissances d'experts internationaux; soutien financier aux partis; dialogues multipartites ; assistance à la conception de programmes de formation à la consolidation de la paix ; le soutien et le maintien des mécanismes de vérification convenus ; soutien aux mécanismes de suivi des plaintes ; et travailler avec les représentants des gouvernements locaux et nationaux pour les rapprocher de leurs circonscriptions.

description.narrative: Mission-Wide Monitoring and Evaluation Project

(Sénégal) : Au cours de l'exercice 2017, Naatal Mbay collaborera avec des institutions financières de premier plan pour développer des modèles et des mécanismes financiers améliorés. Des efforts seront déployés pour coordonner étroitement les activités avec le secteur privé, le gouvernement du Sénégal et d'autres projets financés par des donateurs afin d'accroître l'accès des communautés aux semences certifiées. Afin d'étendre la couverture afin de réaliser des changements systémiques, Naatal Mbay portera le pourcentage de ménages touchés à au moins 50 pour cent du total des ménages dans les régions de Casamance et de la Moyenne Vallée. En tant que thème transversal, les activités de l'exercice 2017 continueront de se concentrer sur le renforcement des capacités des organisations locales et sur les questions d'intégration du genre, en veillant à ce que la programmation soit ajustée de manière continue pour garantir aux participantes un accès complet aux technologies et aux ressources adaptées.

(Senegal): The Economic Growth Project (PCE) is focused on supporting improvements to rice, maize and millet value chains to increase small farmer incomes and improve food security. The Government of Senegal's Rice Self Sufficiency Plan adopted rain-fed rice as a major investment area and elected to redefine its approach to agriculture financing as a result of this project. In FY 2014, PCE will expand its value chain activities in rain-fed and irrigated rice, maize and millet; support seed producer associations in securing an adequate supply of breeder and foundation seeds; and expand access by small farmers to critical financial services, including equipment leasing, seasonal financing, and warehouse collateral. The project will also partner with private firms, farmer unions, and banks to invest in a grain-storage cost-share. PCE will continue to promote rain-indexed insurance, as well as build capacity to improve yield calculation and seasonal forecasting. ($300,000 indirect GCC-A)

Améliorer l’éducation de la petite enfance, l’enseignement primaire et l’enseignement secondaire, dispensés dans des cadres formels ou non formels. Il comprend des programmes d'alphabétisation, de calcul et d'autres compétences de base pour les jeunes et les adultes.

(Sénégal) : Le Projet de croissance économique (PCE) vise à soutenir l’amélioration des chaînes de valeur du riz, du maïs et du mil afin d’augmenter les revenus des petits agriculteurs et d’améliorer la sécurité alimentaire. Le Plan d'autosuffisance en riz du gouvernement du Sénégal a adopté le riz pluvial comme domaine d'investissement majeur et a choisi de redéfinir son approche du financement agricole à la suite de ce projet. Au cours de l'exercice 2014, PCE étendra ses activités de chaîne de valeur dans le riz pluvial et irrigué, le maïs et le mil ; aider les associations de producteurs de semences à garantir un approvisionnement adéquat en semences de sélection et de fondation ; et élargir l'accès des petits agriculteurs aux services financiers essentiels, notamment le crédit-bail d'équipement, le financement saisonnier et la garantie d'entrepôt. Le projet s'associera également à des entreprises privées, des syndicats d'agriculteurs et des banques pour investir dans une participation aux coûts de stockage des céréales. PCE continuera de promouvoir une assurance indexée sur la pluie et de renforcer les capacités pour améliorer le calcul des rendements et les prévisions saisonnières. (300 000 $ GCC-A indirect)

(Mali): With.FY 2021 funds in Year 6, the first year of a two year extension period, the.Mali Justice Project (MJP) will maintain its original design focusing on.activities that drive positive change within the justice sector and increase.the government's capacity to implement justice related reforms and policies.while supporting the implementation of key documents such as the Joint Country.Action Plan of March 2020 (JCAP2) and the Justice Sector Orientation and.Programming Act, 2020-2024. Regarding access to justice, MJP will work with.traditional authorities who will be trained to advance human rights and rule of.law and local CSO partners (including the Malian Bar Association) who provide.legal advisory and dispute resolution services to poor communities and Trafficking.In Persons (TIP) victims. $500,000 of funding within this IM contributes to meeting the required GBV earmark.. MJP will also participate in legal aid policy reforms.and the anti-trafficking in persons' committee to advance anti-TIP policy.measures. At a national policy level, MJP will continue to work towards the.sustainability of civil society led legal aid services by advocating for a.national policy on legal aid, and an acknowledged role for alternative dispute.resolution in the justice system. This will build on MJP's organization of, and.participation in, the June 2019 and November 2019 conferences on paralegalism.and the reform of legal aid in Mali. MJP will continue to build on achievements.and lessons learned during the previous 5 years of activity implementation and.technical assistance interventions, working closely with stakeholders and.partners in order to consolidate capacity development gains, improve efficiency.and transparency at control check points, and further strengthen legal support.mechanisms and advocacy platforms. .

(Mali) : Grâce aux fonds de l'exercice 2021 au cours de la sixième année, la première année d'une période de prolongation de deux ans, le Projet Justice au Mali (MJP) maintiendra sa conception originale en se concentrant sur les activités qui génèrent des changements positifs au sein du secteur de la justice et augmentent la capacité du gouvernement à mettre en œuvre des réformes et des politiques liées à la justice, tout en soutenant la mise en œuvre de documents clés tels que le Plan d'action national conjoint de mars 2020 (JCAP2) et la Loi d'orientation et de programmation du secteur judiciaire. 2020-2024. En ce qui concerne l'accès à la justice, le MJP travaillera avec les autorités traditionnelles qui seront formées pour faire progresser les droits de l'homme et l'État de droit, ainsi qu'avec les OSC partenaires locales (y compris le Barreau malien) qui fournissent des services de conseil juridique et de règlement des différends aux communautés pauvres et aux victimes de la traite des personnes (TIP). Un financement de 500 000 $ au sein de cet IM contribue à atteindre l'objectif requis en matière de VBG. Le MJP participera également aux réformes de la politique d'aide juridique et au comité de lutte contre la traite des personnes pour faire progresser les mesures anti-TIP. Au niveau politique national, le MJP continuera à œuvrer pour la durabilité des services d'aide juridique dirigés par la société civile en plaidant pour une politique nationale en matière d'aide juridique et un rôle reconnu pour le règlement alternatif des différends dans le système judiciaire. Cela s'appuiera sur l'organisation et la participation du MJP aux conférences de juin 2019 et novembre 2019 sur le parajurisme et la réforme de l'aide juridique au Mali. Le MJP continuera de s'appuyer sur les réalisations et les leçons apprises au cours des 5 années précédentes de mise en œuvre des activités et d'interventions d'assistance technique, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes et les partenaires afin de consolider les acquis en matière de développement des capacités, d'améliorer l'efficacité et la transparence aux points de contrôle et de renforcer davantage les mécanismes de soutien juridique et les plateformes de plaidoyer. .

description.narrative: This grant supports activities implemented through WHO country, regional and headquarter offices in support of polio eradication in the context of strengthening immunization and disease control programs. The grant supports USAIDs five-part polio eradication strategy: 1) Partnerships between all interested public and private sector parties; 2) Routine immunization and immunization systems: cold chain; 3) refurbishment/management; 4) Logistics, vaccine forecasting, planning and budgeting at the district; and 5) national levels. Supplemental immunization, operational support to National ImmunizationDays, social mobilization, house-to-house mop upimmunization; Surveillance and case detection for AFP and other reportable diseases;and Information feedback and use.
Personnel (transversal) : Fournisseur de services de mise en œuvre pour l'Agence américaine pour le développement international.

Cette subvention soutient les activités mises en œuvre par les bureaux nationaux, régionaux et du siège de l'OMS en faveur de l'éradication de la poliomyélite dans le contexte du renforcement des programmes de vaccination et de contrôle des maladies. La subvention soutient la stratégie d'éradication de la poliomyélite en cinq volets de l'USAID : 1) Partenariats entre toutes les parties intéressées des secteurs public et privé ; 2) Vaccination de routine et systèmes de vaccination : chaîne du froid ; 3) rénovation/gestion ; 4) Logistique, prévision des vaccins, planification et budgétisation au niveau du district ; et 5) les niveaux nationaux. Vaccination supplémentaire, soutien opérationnel aux Journées nationales de vaccination, mobilisation sociale, vaccination porte-à-porte ; Surveillance et détection des cas de PFA et d'autres maladies à déclaration obligatoire ; et retour d'information et utilisation.

description.narrative: This program supports the Mission's goal for an independent, prosperous, and healthy Ukraine united around core European values in one or more of the following sectors: strengthening of democratic governance, and more inclusive, sustainable, market-driven economic growth.

Cette subvention soutient les activités mises en œuvre par les bureaux nationaux, régionaux et du siège de l'OMS en faveur de l'éradication de la poliomyélite dans le contexte du renforcement des programmes de vaccination et de contrôle des maladies. La subvention soutient la stratégie d'éradication de la poliomyélite en cinq volets de l'USAID : 1) Partenariats entre toutes les parties intéressées des secteurs public et privé ; 2) Vaccination de routine et systèmes de vaccination : chaîne du froid ; 3) rénovation/gestion ; 4) Logistique, prévision des vaccins, planification et budgétisation au niveau du district ; et 5) les niveaux nationaux. Vaccination supplémentaire, soutien opérationnel aux Journées nationales de vaccination, mobilisation sociale, vaccination porte-à-porte ; Surveillance et détection des cas de PFA et d'autres maladies à déclaration obligatoire ; et retour d'information et utilisation.

Episodes feature interviews and expert round tables discussions

title.narrative: Accelerating Development of Abiotic Stress Tolerant Rice and Wheat

description.narrative: The Accelerating Development of Abiotic Stress Tolerant Rice and Wheat activity supports Arcadia Biosciences Inc. to conduct research in conjunction with the Bangladesh Rice Research Institute (BRRI) on developing saline tolerant rice seed varieties. The goals of the activity are to increase crop productivity; improve national agriculture research capacity; and improve the national climate for the acceptance of the development, management and use of genetically modified crops. To achieve these goals the activity will conduct greenhouse and field research using genetically modified plant materials developed in the United States, produce new seed varieties, conduct trainings on the new varieties, and pursue the licensing of genetically modified new varieties for their release. Implementing partners will also conduct regular consultations with the Government of Bangladesh to establish a regulatory system for the use and management of genetically modified varieties.

The International Finance Corporation (IFC) Public International Organization grant (PIO) seeks to develop and implement effective business reforms such as the removal of regulatory business barriers. The project targets the creation of a functional business environment that is conducive to economic growth, jobs creation, reduced burdensome regulatory controls, and increased international trade. E3/Trade and Regulatory Reform (E3/TRR) funding supports a multi-donor effort to improve monitoring and evaluation efforts together with the creation of M&E frameworks, literature reviews, several impact evaluations, and a cost-benefit analysis. E3/TRR is also planning to support the development of new indicators to measure outcomes involving regulation and transparency; these indicators are expected to impact the evaluation of the next generation of regulatory reforms.

La subvención de Organización Internacional Pública (PIO) de la Corporación Financiera Internacional (IFC) busca desarrollar e implementar reformas comerciales efectivas, como la eliminación de barreras comerciales regulatorias. El proyecto tiene como objetivo la creación de un entorno empresarial funcional que conduzca al crecimiento económico, la creación de empleo, la reducción de los controles regulatorios onerosos y el aumento del comercio internacional. El financiamiento del E3/Comercio y Reforma Regulatoria (E3/TRR) apoya un esfuerzo de múltiples donantes para mejorar los esfuerzos de monitoreo y evaluación junto con la creación de marcos de M&E, revisiones de literatura, varias evaluaciones de impacto y un análisis de costo-beneficio. E3/TRR también planea apoyar el desarrollo de nuevos indicadores para medir los resultados relacionados con la regulación y la transparencia; Se espera que estos indicadores impacten la evaluación de la próxima generación de reformas regulatorias.

description.narrative: NRM Partcipating Agency Service Agreement with USDA (NEW)

title.narrative: Risk Management for Food Security in Bangladesh – Sanitary and Phyto-Sanitary (SPS) Food Safety Project.
Gestión de riesgos para la seguridad alimentaria en Bangladesh – Proyecto de inocuidad de los alimentos sanitarios y fitosanitarios (SPS).

description.narrative: (Bangladesh): This activity aims to improve food safety and food security for Bangladeshi consumers. Specifically, the activity will train Bangladeshi governmental extension service, plant protection, quarantine officials and inspectors to improve food safety risk identification skills, ensure better coordination among the various parties associated with food safety, and train laboratory network technicians in the provision of improved food risk characterization. The goals of this USDA implemented activity include improved food safety policies and legislation, improved use of pesticides and integrated pest management, strengthened enforcement of food safety legislation, improved risk-based inspection and pest and disease identification, the adoption of best practices in aquaculture, manufacturing and sanitation, improved food safety laboratory management, and stronger adherence to international trade standards and agreements. USDA will also pilot a rural Market Center focused on food safety.

(Bangladesh): Esta actividad tiene como objetivo mejorar la seguridad alimentaria y la seguridad alimentaria para los consumidores de Bangladesh. Específicamente, la actividad capacitará a inspectores y funcionarios del servicio de extensión gubernamental, protección fitosanitaria y cuarentena del gobierno de Bangladesh para mejorar las habilidades de identificación de riesgos de inocuidad de los alimentos, garantizar una mejor coordinación entre las diversas partes asociadas con la inocuidad de los alimentos y capacitar a técnicos de redes de laboratorios en la provisión de una mejor caracterización de riesgos de los alimentos. Los objetivos de esta actividad implementada por el USDA incluyen mejores políticas y legislación sobre seguridad alimentaria, un mejor uso de pesticidas y manejo integrado de plagas, una mayor aplicación de la legislación sobre seguridad alimentaria, una mejor inspección basada en riesgos e identificación de plagas y enfermedades, la adopción de mejores prácticas en acuicultura, fabricación y saneamiento, una mejor gestión de laboratorios de seguridad alimentaria y una mayor adherencia a los estándares y acuerdos comerciales internacionales. El USDA también pondrá a prueba un centro de mercado rural centrado en la seguridad alimentaria.

(USAID Economic Growth, Education and Environment (E3)): This Participating Agency Service Agreement (PASA) provides E3/Education with technically qualified and experienced professionals in the areas of education and training, economic policy, trade and regulatory reform, and program support. It assists by making available technical leadership and field support; supporting for the evaluation process, research, learning, and outreach.This mechanism also provides administrative support to the PASA technical staff, as well as short-term technical assistance to meet specialized requests.

title.narrative: USDA PASA 2: Technical Services - I&E, GCC and PR Participation

description.narrative: (USAID Economic Growth, Education and Environment (E3)): Through this Participating Agency Service Agreement (PASA), USAID obtains the services of US Department of Agriculture (USDA), to provide support to E3 Offices, noted above: (1) Infrastructure and Energy, (2) Poverty Reduction, and (3) Global Climate Change. USDA provides technical staff to carry out its technical leadership, program management, and field support responsibilities.

Mejora de la capacidad para estrategias de desarrollo bajas en emisiones

description.narrative: Enhancing Capacity for Low Emission Development Strategies (EC-LEDS) is a flagship U.S. government effort that assists partner countries in developing and implementing LEDS. The program, which advances the international goals of theU.S. Climate Action Plan, enhances partner country efforts by providing targeted technical assistance and building a shared global knowledge base on LEDS.

title.narrative: Greenhouse Gas Inventory Capacity Building - EPA

description.narrative: (USAID Economic Growth, Education and Environment (E3)): This activity addresses the challenges USAID faces in monitoring and reporting on the long-term impacts of climate change mitigation programs. Building upon the 'Clean Energy Emission Reduction' protocol and tools, this activity will design and develop a robust web-based reporting tool for calculating Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emission reductions from USAID clean energy activities. This activity will provide further training and piloting assistance to operating units coupled with other mitigation-related monitoring and reporting support, through both remote and in-country assistance. Through this work, E3/Global Climate Change (E3/GCC) will develop approaches to further assess the short, medium, and long-term impact of Clean Energy (CE) policy creation and capacity building activities. This program will also assist in better tracking the long-term impacts of CE funded programs, including GHG emissions reductions, Megawatts installed, and finances leveraged in addressing CE issues. (Direct GCC-Clean Energy - $1,000,000)
