description.narrative: This Grant supports the World Health Organization/Africa Regional Offices (WHO/AFRO) program to eradicate polio in Africa. WHO/AFRO supports Member States in the following six (6) areas: (1) Developing partnerships to support polio eradication and vaccination; (2) Strengthening immunization delivery systems; (3) Improving planning, implementation, and monitoring of supplemental immunizations; (4) Improving acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) surveillance and response; (5) Supporting certification, containment, and post-certification policy development; and (6) Improving information dissemination to improve polio eradication activity quality.

description.narrative: (USAID Africa Regional): In 2022, and for the third consecutive year, the Sahel and West Africa region faced a major food and nutrition crisis with 38.3 million people potentially affected in June-August. The conflict in Ukraine poses a high risk of exacerbating the crisis, particularly with an increase in the inflationary threats of food and agricultural input prices. Through the Public International Organization (PIO) project contribution grant to the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), USAID Africa Regional will continue its collaboration with the USAID West Africa Regional Economic Growth Office to support the Sahel and West Africa Club (SWAC) to enable it to provide thought leadership and analytical assistance on emerging sub-continent wide trends including urban agglomeration and youth. With FY 2022 funds, this grant will support SWAC's analytical work program on regional food security governance, regional food system policies, urban border economies, and the impacts of terrorist violence on cross-border food trade. Due to the uncertainties related to the Ukraine conflict and its consequences on the 17 member states of the ECOWAS, WAEMU, and CILSS, additional resources would allow SWAC to reactivate and maintain the monitoring mechanism over three semesters from June 2022 to December 2023. FY 2022 funds in the amount of $250,000 for this IM contribute to AFR Regional's Global Food Security directive of $2,000,000..

title.narrative: OEGI- Ground Water Exploration and Assessment

description.narrative: (Kenya): The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) supports the Government of Kenya with remote sensing, mapping, and groundwater modeling to determine the amount of ground water availability in Kenya. USGS will work with local partners to identify sources of existing hydrogeologic and hydrologic data; acquire and interpret remotely sensed data; generate preliminary maps for groundwater supply development; identify data gaps and develop plans for investigations; evaluate conceptual models to interpret remotely-sensed data; conduct training sessions on these findings. The activity will provide data on productive water aquifers suitable for human consumption, and contribute to long-term planning for drinking water. Kenya is classified as water scarce country with average freshwater supply estimated to be half of the UN's threshold for water scarcity. In water scarce areas, natural resource conflicts are increasing. The funds will expand the mapping of groundwater resources to additional counties, train government of Kenya staff on the application of data, and develop a platform for overall groundwater coordination efforts. The activity promotes sustainability by empowering county and national governments and their water companies to effectively manage their water resources. These efforts directly contribute to the US Global Water Strategy Strategic Objective Two: Encourage the sound management and protection of freshwater resources. This activity will help address water scarcity challenges, which can exacerbate political instability and cause social unrest, thus contributing to greater regional stability, a U.S. foreign policy objective. $100,000 of funding within this IM contributes to meeting the required "adaptation indirect" earmark". Studies include identification of recharge areas. This enables communities and host governments to ensure they are conserved to help replenish the groundwater which will help to reduce risks associated with climate change.

description.narrative: This PIO grant to INTERPOL funds the Combating Environmental Crime grant. The grant builds on the previous Project PREDATOR (tiger and snow leopard conservation) to include a wider range of environmental crimes addressed by Interpol's Environmental Security Sub-Directorate. In addition to PREDATOR, support is anticipated for Project SCALE (illegal fishing), Project WISDOM (elephant ivory and rhino horn), and Project LEAF (illegal timber). The broadened scope recognizes that many of the same criminal syndicates involved in tiger and snow leopard trafficking are also engaged in transcontinental trafficking in ivory, rhino horn, timber, etc.

description.narrative: Activities under Market Access for Vulnerable Populations seek to ensure the benefits of market participation reach the most vulnerable. Activities include investments to ensure that gender and access to markets by men and women and nutritional deficits that undermine the human capital necessary to participate in markets are adequately addressed in both FTF programs and government-led national strategies. Market access activities also bolster the role of civil society to ensure the benefits of more efficient markets are inclusive. Finally, Market Access activities build the resilience of people and places caught at the intersection of chronic poverty and exposure to shocks and stresses and subject to recurrent crisis. By doing so, these activities bring market solutions to the challenge of recurrent crisis, particularly where these crisis have resulted in repeat, large-scale humanitarian emergencies

description.narrative: (USAID Bureau For Food Security (BFS)): .Purpose of Activity: The World Bank's Umbrella Facility for Gender Equality (UFGE) Multi-donor Trust Fund supports impact evaluations to help answer gender-focused questions in the Feed the Future Learning Agenda. The three impact evaluations currently funded:..Ethiopia: Evaluation of a mentoring program in Ethiopia that targets women agribusiness managers.Nigeria: Evaluation of a household mentoring program to deliver livelihood planning and training, called the caseworker model, and an unconditional cash transfer program for women in extremely vulnerable households. Tanzania: Evaluation of a new horticulture activity, to be awarded August 2016. ..Description of Activities: The project will finalize baseline data collection and complete a baseline report for the Nigeria impact evaluation, finalize the impact evaluation design and collect data for Tanzania, and complete mid-line data collection, report, and final data collection for the Ethiopia evaluation.....

description.narrative: The Program for Biosafety Systems (PBS) has over 10 years of experience working with policy-makers, regulators and scientists in Africa and SE Asia to provide policy advice and build capacity for informed decision-making about agricultural biotechnology innovations. PBS uses an integrated approach of legal, technical and communications services. PBS creates an enabling.environment which allows for the uptake and adoption of improved plant varieties which supports the GFSS goal of reducing global hunger, malnutrition,and poverty.

(USAID Bureau For Food Security (BFS)): Purpose of Activity: The goal of this grant is to gather evidence and promote learning about Feed the Future activities through impact evaluations. IFPRI will (1) design and facilitate independent rigorous impact evaluations of FTF programs, (2) provide technical assistance and capacity building services to USAID staff and partner nation personnel to carry out required data collection to support the evaluation, (3) conduct data analysis and produce reports on evaluation findings that are clear and accessible to multiple audiences, and (4) disseminate findings and lessons from impact evaluations..Description of Activities: In FY 16, IFPRI will collect input samples from 10 market locations throughout Uganda and conduct testing to test for adulteration and counterfeiting. For the impact evaluation, IFPRI will conduct data collection around second season to measure the change in input usage...

description.narrative: International Fertilizer Development Centre (IFDC) will initiate activities aimed to develop a harmonized fertilizer quality regulatory system (FQRS) for the member countries of COMESA in East and Southern Africa. This activity supports U.S. economic interest as it engages U.S. private sector and U.S. University expertise to address the GFSS goal of reducing global hunger, malnutrition, and poverty..Description of Activities: Project activities and interventions are characterized into three major focus areas: 1) Developing and diffusing technologies that address nutrient management and promote sustainable agricultural intensification; 2) Conducting evidence-based policy analysis (fertilizer policy assessments, impact assessments and economic studies) to support reform; and 3) Documenting and analyzing knowledge generated from activities to improve productivity and food security.

Le Centre international de développement des engrais (IFDC) lancera des activités visant à développer un système harmonisé de réglementation de la qualité des engrais (FQRS) pour les pays membres du COMESA en Afrique orientale et australe. Cette activité soutient les intérêts économiques des États-Unis car elle engage le secteur privé américain et l'expertise des universités américaines pour atteindre l'objectif du GFSS de réduction de la faim, de la malnutrition et de la pauvreté dans le monde. Description des activités : Les activités et les interventions du projet se caractérisent par trois domaines d'intervention majeurs : 1) Développement et diffusion de technologies qui abordent la gestion des nutriments et favorisent l'intensification agricole durable ; 2) Mener une analyse politique fondée sur des données factuelles (évaluations des politiques en matière d'engrais, évaluations d'impact et études économiques) pour soutenir la réforme ; et 3) Documenter et analyser les connaissances générées par les activités visant à améliorer la productivité et la sécurité alimentaire.

description.narrative: (USAID Bureau For Food Security (BFS)): Purpose: .The grant supports the World Bank's Living Standards Measurement Study (LSMS) Multi-Donor Trust Fund in strengthening national statistical systems including the availability, quality, use and usability of household surveys in Feed the Future countries. It is a component of the Feed the Future Core Agricultural and Rural Data Surveys (CARDS) project...Activities:.Activities include technical assistance on the design and implementation of household surveys, methodological research on best practices in survey methods, and increased promotion and dissemination of data. 2019 funding supports methodological research, analytical support, capacity building, and outreach. This activity aims to build the capacity of partner countries in survey design, execution, data analysis and use in support of their journey to self-reliance, a USAID priority. . .As the multilateral organization overseeing the Multi-Donor Trust Fund and its 30+ year history generating high-quality data, incorporating innovative technologies and improved survey methodologies, and building technical capacity of host countries, the World Bank has a comparative advantage in conducting this work and thus, was chosen non-competitively to carry out this work, following USAID procurement policies............

Le Centre international de développement des engrais (IFDC) lancera des activités visant à développer un système harmonisé de réglementation de la qualité des engrais (FQRS) pour les pays membres du COMESA en Afrique orientale et australe. Cette activité soutient les intérêts économiques des États-Unis car elle engage le secteur privé américain et l'expertise des universités américaines pour atteindre l'objectif du GFSS de réduction de la faim, de la malnutrition et de la pauvreté dans le monde. Description des activités : Les activités et les interventions du projet se caractérisent par trois domaines d'intervention majeurs : 1) Développement et diffusion de technologies qui abordent la gestion des nutriments et favorisent l'intensification agricole durable ; 2) Mener une analyse politique fondée sur des données factuelles (évaluations des politiques en matière d'engrais, évaluations d'impact et études économiques) pour soutenir la réforme ; et 3) Documenter et analyser les connaissances générées par les activités visant à améliorer la productivité et la sécurité alimentaire.

(Oficina de Seguridad Alimentaria (BFS) de USAID): Propósito: La subvención apoya el Fondo Fiduciario de Donantes Múltiples para el Estudio de Medición de los Niveles de Vida (LSMS) del Banco Mundial en el fortalecimiento de los sistemas estadísticos nacionales, incluida la disponibilidad, la calidad, el uso y la usabilidad de las encuestas de hogares en los países de Feed the Future. Es un componente del proyecto Feed the Future Core Agriculture and Rural Data Surveys (CARDS)...Actividades: Las actividades incluyen asistencia técnica para el diseño e implementación de encuestas de hogares, investigación metodológica sobre mejores prácticas en métodos de encuesta y una mayor promoción y difusión de datos. La financiación de 2019 apoya la investigación metodológica, el apoyo analítico, el desarrollo de capacidades y la divulgación. Esta actividad tiene como objetivo desarrollar la capacidad de los países socios en el diseño, ejecución, análisis de datos y uso de encuestas en apoyo de su camino hacia la autosuficiencia, una prioridad de USAID. . .Como organización multilateral que supervisa el Fondo Fiduciario de Donantes Múltiples y sus más de 30 años de historia generando datos de alta calidad, incorporando tecnologías innovadoras y metodologías de encuesta mejoradas, y desarrollando la capacidad técnica de los países anfitriones, el Banco Mundial tiene una ventaja comparativa en la realización de este trabajo y, por lo tanto, fue elegido de manera no competitiva para realizarlo, siguiendo las políticas de adquisiciones de USAID....

The purpose of the activity is to support pilots of the Agricultural Integrated Survey (AGRIS) in four countries. AGRIS is a new farm-based survey tool to help countries establish an integrated programme of agricultural surveys that generates core data recommended under the "Global Strategy to Improve Agricultural and Rural Statistics." This is a core component of the Feed the Future Core Agricultural and Rural Data Surveys (CARDS) project.

Purpose: The Regional Strategic Analysis and Knowledge Support System (ReSAKSS) has the goal of mobilizing research to inform policies that reduce poverty and hunger. It accomplishes this through the creation and strengthening of a regional network of food policy researchers, analysts, and development practitioners to make research results, data, and information readily available to policy makers. Activities: Project activities 1) Strengthening Sub-regional Networks to Enhance Knowledge Sharing and Policy Influence; 2) Developing Evidence to Inform Policy; 3) Strengthening Agriculture and Food Security Policy Capacity; 4) Analytical Support to USAID Policy Strategy. ReSAKSS produces annual trends and outlook reports, analyzes issues, and helps to establish country platforms. The direct beneficiaries of this work are African policymakers, policy analysts, modeling experts, and researchers, who are engaged in designing, implementing, and M&E.

(Bureau de l'USAID pour la sécurité alimentaire (BFS)) : Objectif : . La subvention soutient le Fonds fiduciaire multi-donateurs de l'étude sur la mesure des niveaux de vie (LSMS) de la Banque mondiale pour renforcer les systèmes statistiques nationaux, y compris la disponibilité, la qualité, l'utilisation et la facilité d'utilisation des enquêtes auprès des ménages dans les pays de Feed the Future. Il s'agit d'une composante du projet Feed the Future Core Agricultural and Rural Data Surveys (CARDS)... Activités : Les activités comprennent une assistance technique pour la conception et la mise en œuvre d'enquêtes auprès des ménages, une recherche méthodologique sur les meilleures pratiques en matière de méthodes d'enquête et une promotion et une diffusion accrues des données. Le financement de 2019 soutient la recherche méthodologique, le soutien analytique, le renforcement des capacités et la sensibilisation. Cette activité vise à renforcer les capacités des pays partenaires en matière de conception, d'exécution, d'analyse et d'utilisation des données à l'appui de leur parcours vers l'autonomie, une priorité de l'USAID. . .En tant qu'organisation multilatérale supervisant le Fonds fiduciaire multidonateurs et ayant plus de 30 ans d'histoire générant des données de haute qualité, intégrant des technologies innovantes et des méthodologies d'enquête améliorées, et renforçant les capacités techniques des pays hôtes, la Banque mondiale a un avantage comparatif dans la conduite de ce travail et a donc été choisie de manière non compétitive pour mener à bien ce travail, conformément aux politiques d'achat de l'USAID.............\

description.narrative: Through the Feed the Future initiative, the National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS) and the Economic Research Services (ERS) of the U.S.~Department of Agriculture (USDA) will build the statistical and analytical capacity of the Government of Rwanda through the Ministry of Agriculture (MINAGRI) and the National Institute of Statistics in Rwanda (NISR) to establish and maintain a sustainable and cost effective agricultural data system.

A través de la iniciativa Feed the Future, el Servicio Nacional de Estadísticas Agrícolas (NASS) y los Servicios de Investigación Económica (ERS) del Departamento de Agricultura de los EE. UU. (USDA) desarrollarán la capacidad estadística y analítica del Gobierno de Ruanda a través del Ministerio de Agricultura (MINAGRI) y el Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas de Ruanda (NISR) para establecer y mantener un sistema de datos agrícolas sostenible y rentable.

description.narrative: The purpose of the PASA agreement is to maintain USAID's leadership role in international agricultural research activities for increased food security and economic growth through agricultural development at the household, community, national and international levels.

title.narrative: Food Safety Systems Strengthening to Support Private Sector Engagement
Fortalecimiento de los sistemas de inocuidad de los alimentos para apoyar la participación del sector privado

description.narrative: Purpose: Strengthen the capacity of sanitary and phytosanitary systems in focus countries, addressing food safety, nutrition and public health objectives, through preventative measures such as those described in the U.S. Food Safety Modernization Act for animal and plant health measures that strengthen trade. This interagency network is a resource for addressing food safety that will result in food products that meet regional and international market and trade standards as well as demand for safe home consumption, preventing food borne diseases and malnutrition. Activities: Food safety and market assessments, regional events; in-country bilateral workshops; development of national and regional training curricula (in-person and online); hiring and deployment of resident SPS Advisors; and/or long-term technical training programs.

Propósito: Fortalecer la capacidad de los sistemas sanitarios y fitosanitarios en los países focales, abordando objetivos de inocuidad de los alimentos, nutrición y salud pública, a través de medidas preventivas como las descritas en la Ley de Modernización de la Inocuidad de los Alimentos de EE. UU. para medidas de sanidad animal y vegetal que fortalezcan el comercio. Esta red interinstitucional es un recurso para abordar la inocuidad de los alimentos que dará como resultado productos alimenticios que cumplan con los estándares comerciales y del mercado regional e internacional, así como con la demanda de consumo doméstico seguro, previniendo las enfermedades transmitidas por los alimentos y la desnutrición. Actividades: Evaluaciones de mercado y seguridad alimentaria, eventos regionales; talleres bilaterales en los países; desarrollo de currículos de capacitación nacionales y regionales (presenciales y en línea); contratación y despliegue de asesores MSF residentes; y/o programas de capacitación técnica de larga duración.

description.narrative: (USAID Economic Growth, Education and Environment (E3)): This activity is now known as Women and the Web. It is a public-private partnership among USAID, NetHope, Intel Corporation, World Pulse, World Vision, UN Women, and Women in Technology in Nigeria. Alliance partners will combine efforts to transform the lives and livelihoods of girls and women in Africa through digital literacy training, relevant content, policy work, and online social networks. The Alliance will introduce girls and women to the transformative benefits of the Internet. All partners share a common interest in increasing access to and use of the Internet to realize the socio-economic benefits for all of bringing more girls and women online. This effort will expand opportunities for young women to generate greater income, receive a quality education, increase their sense of empowerment and equity, extend their support networks, and increase their political participation. Funding to support this activity comes from the Women's Leadership initiative.~

description.narrative: This award is for a direct administrative costs or operating expenses of the U.S. Agency for International Development.

Increase availability and use of proven nutrition interventions to reduce mortality, morbidity, and food insecurity, including nutrition education to improve maternal diets, nutrition during pregnancy, exclusive breastfeeding, and infant and young child feeding practices; fortified or biofortified staple foods, specialized food products, and community gardens to improve consumption of quality food; and delivery of nutrition services including micronutrient supplementation and community management of acute malnutrition. Strengthen host country capacity by advancing supportive nutrition and food security policies and improving nutrition information systems.

Aumentar a disponibilidade e a utilização de intervenções nutricionais comprovadas para reduzir a mortalidade, a morbilidade e a insegurança alimentar, incluindo a educação nutricional para melhorar as dietas maternas, a nutrição durante a gravidez, a amamentação exclusiva e as práticas de alimentação de bebés e crianças pequenas; alimentos básicos fortificados ou biofortificados, produtos alimentares especializados e hortas comunitárias para melhorar o consumo de alimentos de qualidade; e prestação de serviços de nutrição, incluindo suplementação de micronutrientes e gestão comunitária da desnutrição aguda. Reforçar a capacidade do país anfitrião, promovendo políticas de apoio à nutrição e à segurança alimentar e melhorando os sistemas de informação nutricional.

description.narrative: Supports the following illustrative program-funded costs: salaries of US, FSN, and TCN and other staff such as PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs working for the US Government managing, administering, and supporting programs and their program-funded benefits such as housing, travel, transportation, education allowances etc; institutional contractors that provide such staff, rent, IT services, the program-funded share of utilities, staff training costs and the cost of developing and administering training programs, equipment and supplies, ICASS, vehicle fuel and maintenance, maintenance contracts, janitorial services, operational unit web page development and maintenance, outreach such as publications and the cost of their preparation (including staff costs), and technical assistance to ensure USG compliance with regulations.

Assist youth and adults in acquiring knowledge and developing skills beyond basic literacy and numeracy which are part of the basic education element, attitudes, and behaviors to find legitimate jobs, establish viable self-employment ventures, and stay employed and productive in a changing economy. Create policies, programs, and systems that respond to labor market demands in the formal and informal sectors.

description.narrative: Develop and conduct needs assessments, baseline studies, targeted evaluations, special studies or other information-gathering efforts specifically for the design, monitoring and evaluation of USG-funded programs. This sub-element may also include developing and disseminating best practices and lessons learned, testing demonstration and/or pilot models, or the preparation of strategic plans and other short-term programming tasks. Note: All such activities that are carried out by partners as an integral part of their monitoring and evaluation efforts for programs funded under other sub-elements should be included within those sub-elements.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

description.narrative: Supports the following illustrative program-funded costs: salaries of US, FSN, and TCN and other staff such as PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs working for the US Government managing, administering, and supporting programs and their program-funded benefits such as housing, travel, transportation, education allowances etc; institutional contractors that provide such staff, rent, IT services, the program-funded share of utilities, staff training costs and the cost of developing and administering training programs, equipment and supplies, ICASS, vehicle fuel and maintenance, maintenance contracts, janitorial services, operational unit web page development and maintenance, outreach such as publications and the cost of their preparation (including staff costs), and technical assistance to ensure USG compliance with regulations.
Ce prix concerne les frais administratifs directs ou les dépenses de fonctionnement de l'Agence américaine pour le développement international.

Prend en charge les coûts indicatifs suivants financés par le programme : les salaires des États-Unis, du FSN et du TCN et d'autres membres du personnel tels que les PSC, les RSSA, les PASA et les CASU travaillant pour le gouvernement américain qui gèrent, administrent et soutiennent les programmes et leurs avantages financés par le programme tels que le logement, les voyages, le transport, les allocations d'études, etc. ; les entrepreneurs institutionnels qui fournissent ce personnel, le loyer, les services informatiques, la part des services publics financée par le programme, les coûts de formation du personnel et les coûts de développement et d'administration des programmes de formation, des équipements et des fournitures, l'ICASS, le carburant et l'entretien des véhicules, les contrats de maintenance, les services de conciergerie, le développement et la maintenance des pages Web des unités opérationnelles, la sensibilisation telle que les publications et le coût de leur préparation (y compris les coûts de personnel), et l'assistance technique pour garantir la conformité du gouvernement américain aux réglementations.

Respalda los siguientes costos ilustrativos financiados por programas: salarios de EE. UU., FSN y TCN y otro personal como PSC, RSSA, PASA, CASU que trabajan para el gobierno de EE. UU. que gestionan, administran y apoyan programas y sus beneficios financiados por programas, como vivienda, viajes, transporte, asignaciones educativas, etc.; contratistas institucionales que proporcionan dicho personal, alquiler, servicios de TI, la parte financiada por el programa de los servicios públicos, costos de capacitación del personal y el costo de desarrollar y administrar programas, equipos y suministros de capacitación, ICASS, combustible y mantenimiento de vehículos, contratos de mantenimiento, servicios de limpieza, desarrollo y mantenimiento de la página web de la unidad operativa, divulgación como publicaciones y el costo de su preparación (incluidos los costos de personal) y asistencia técnica para garantizar el cumplimiento de las regulaciones del Gobierno de los Estados Unidos.

description.narrative: This program supports the Mission's goal for an independent, prosperous, and healthy Ukraine united around core European values in one or more of the following sectors: strengthening of democratic governance, and more inclusive, sustainable, market-driven economic growth.

Prend en charge les coûts indicatifs suivants financés par le programme : les salaires des États-Unis, du FSN et du TCN et d'autres membres du personnel tels que les PSC, les RSSA, les PASA et les CASU travaillant pour le gouvernement américain qui gèrent, administrent et soutiennent les programmes et leurs avantages financés par le programme tels que le logement, les voyages, le transport, les allocations d'études, etc. ; les entrepreneurs institutionnels qui fournissent ce personnel, le loyer, les services informatiques, la part des services publics financée par le programme, les coûts de formation du personnel et les coûts de développement et d'administration des programmes de formation, des équipements et des fournitures, l'ICASS, le carburant et l'entretien des véhicules, les contrats de maintenance, les services de conciergerie, le développement et la maintenance des pages Web des unités opérationnelles, la sensibilisation telle que les publications et le coût de leur préparation (y compris les coûts de personnel), et l'assistance technique pour garantir la conformité du gouvernement américain aux réglementations.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

description.narrative: Strengthen and support communications networks.

Supports the following illustrative program-funded costs: salaries of US, FSN, and TCN and other staff such as PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs working for the US Government managing, administering, and supporting programs and their program-funded benefits such as housing, travel, transportation, education allowances etc; institutional contractors that provide such staff, rent, IT services, the program-funded share of utilities, staff training costs and the cost of developing and administering training programs, equipment and supplies, ICASS, vehicle fuel and maintenance, maintenance contracts, janitorial services, operational unit web page development and maintenance, outreach such as publications and the cost of their preparation (including staff costs), and technical assistance to ensure USG compliance with regulations.

Prend en charge les coûts indicatifs suivants financés par le programme : les salaires des États-Unis, du FSN et du TCN et d'autres membres du personnel tels que les PSC, les RSSA, les PASA et les CASU travaillant pour le gouvernement américain qui gèrent, administrent et soutiennent les programmes et leurs avantages financés par le programme tels que le logement, les voyages, le transport, les allocations d'études, etc. ; les entrepreneurs institutionnels qui fournissent ce personnel, le loyer, les services informatiques, la part des services publics financée par le programme, les coûts de formation du personnel et les coûts de développement et d'administration des programmes de formation, des équipements et des fournitures, l'ICASS, le carburant et l'entretien des véhicules, les contrats de maintenance, les services de conciergerie, le développement et la maintenance des pages Web des unités opérationnelles, la sensibilisation telle que les publications et le coût de leur préparation (y compris les coûts de personnel), et l'assistance technique pour garantir la conformité du gouvernement américain aux réglementations.

Develop and conduct needs assessments, baseline studies, targeted evaluations, special studies or other information-gathering efforts specifically for the design, monitoring and evaluation of USG-funded programs. This sub-element may also include developing and disseminating best practices and lessons learned, testing demonstration and/or pilot models, or the preparation of strategic plans and other short-term programming tasks. Note: All such activities that are carried out by partners as an integral part of their monitoring and evaluation efforts for programs funded under other sub-elements should be included within those sub-elements.

Prend en charge les coûts indicatifs suivants financés par le programme : les salaires des États-Unis, du FSN et du TCN et d'autres membres du personnel tels que les PSC, les RSSA, les PASA et les CASU travaillant pour le gouvernement américain qui gèrent, administrent et soutiennent les programmes et leurs avantages financés par le programme tels que le logement, les voyages, le transport, les allocations d'études, etc. ; les entrepreneurs institutionnels qui fournissent ce personnel, le loyer, les services informatiques, la part des services publics financée par le programme, les coûts de formation du personnel et les coûts de développement et d'administration des programmes de formation, des équipements et des fournitures, l'ICASS, le carburant et l'entretien des véhicules, les contrats de maintenance, les services de conciergerie, le développement et la maintenance des pages Web des unités opérationnelles, la sensibilisation telle que les publications et le coût de leur préparation (y compris les coûts de personnel), et l'assistance technique pour garantir la conformité du gouvernement américain aux réglementations.

Développer et mener des évaluations des besoins, des études de base, des évaluations ciblées, des études spéciales ou d'autres efforts de collecte d'informations spécifiquement pour la conception, le suivi et l'évaluation des programmes financés par le gouvernement américain. Ce sous-élément peut également inclure l’élaboration et la diffusion des meilleures pratiques et des enseignements tirés, le test de modèles de démonstration et/ou pilotes, ou la préparation de plans stratégiques et d’autres tâches de programmation à court terme. Remarque : Toutes les activités menées par les partenaires dans le cadre de leurs efforts de suivi et d'évaluation des programmes financés au titre d'autres sous-éléments doivent être incluses dans ces sous-éléments.

description.narrative: This program supports the Mission's goal for an independent, prosperous, and healthy Ukraine united around core European values in one or more of the following sectors: strengthening of democratic governance, and more inclusive, sustainable, market-driven economic growth.

Développer et mener des évaluations des besoins, des études de base, des évaluations ciblées, des études spéciales ou d'autres efforts de collecte d'informations spécifiquement pour la conception, le suivi et l'évaluation des programmes financés par le gouvernement américain. Ce sous-élément peut également inclure l’élaboration et la diffusion des meilleures pratiques et des enseignements tirés, le test de modèles de démonstration et/ou pilotes, ou la préparation de plans stratégiques et d’autres tâches de programmation à court terme. Remarque : Toutes les activités menées par les partenaires dans le cadre de leurs efforts de suivi et d'évaluation des programmes financés au titre d'autres sous-éléments doivent être incluses dans ces sous-éléments.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

description.narrative: Strengthen the legal, regulatory, institutional, and information environment which protects and enables the growth in associational life and the development of independent and sustainable civil society organizations (CSOs). Build the capacity of civil society organizations to act as agents for reform and support their participation in democratic decision-making through articulating and representing their members interests, engaging in service delivery, and advocating for issues which become part of the public agenda and are reflected in public policies. Encourage the strengthening of a civic culture which supports democratic institutions and processes, active participation in political and civic life, and the civic virtues of tolerance, pluralism, compromise, trust, and respect for individual rights, including gender equality.

Consortium pour les élections et le renforcement des processus politiques (CEPPS) : soutenir la participation civique et la recherche d'un consensus dans les processus politiques.

description.narrative: The program is to provide technical and training support to promote participatory and legitimate political process in Sudan through political party development and legislative strengthening. Activities aim to promote the establishment and/or development of institutions which will ensure a viable peace at national, regional, and local level.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

Le programme vise à fournir un soutien technique et de formation pour promouvoir un processus politique participatif et légitime au Soudan à travers le développement des partis politiques et le renforcement de la législation. Les activités visent à promouvoir la création et/ou le développement d'institutions qui garantiront une paix viable aux niveaux national, régional et local.

description.narrative: Improve the ability of the USG, host countries and other partners to prepare for and mitigate the effects of disasters, including both natural disasters and complex emergencies, taking into account the differences in men and womens freedom of movement and access to information. Activities under this component include any efforts to enhance the capacities of the USG (in Washington and in the field), humanitarian assistance providers, national host-country authorities, and local communities to engage in disaster reduction and response activities. Activities consist of standardized and coordinated assessments, monitoring, information sharing, data and situational analysis, joint planning; enhancement of coping mechanisms, including the capacity to address adaptation to constantly changing situations on the ground including climate variability and climate change.

Provide goods, personnel, services and assistance to meet basic human needs in order to foster transition from relief according to principles of universality, impartiality and human dignity. This element should be done, when possible, as part of an integrated, coordinated and/or multi-sectoral approach.

description.narrative: Ensure full respect for the rights of the individual and communities in accordance with the letter and the spirit of the relevant bodies of law (international humanitarian, human rights, and refugee law). This involves both legal and practical approaches for implementation in humanitarian situations, including efforts to ensure humanitarian access, incorporate protection strategies in assistance programming and other measures to reduce vulnerability and uphold human dignity for all victims of conflict and disasters. Activities included herein should be linked to relevant GJD/Human Rights elements.

description.narrative: Strengthening Democratic Institutions (SDI) overall objective is to strengthen democratic institutions in Bolivia, while facilitating constructive citizen participation in the democratic process at both the national and regional levels of government. To achieve this, the program features three central components designed to: 1. Promote decentralization and regional development, and improve the transparency and investment management capabilities of departmental prefectures. 2. Improve the capacity of citizens to exercise their rights and responsibilities effectively, and of civil society organizations to monitor the political process and lead pluralistic debate. 3. Strengthen the capacity of the National Congress to function effectively and transparently in a manner that promotes pluralistic debate.

El objetivo general de Fortalecimiento de las Instituciones Democráticas (IDE) es fortalecer las instituciones democráticas en Bolivia, al tiempo que se facilita la participación ciudadana constructiva en el proceso democrático tanto a nivel nacional como regional de gobierno. Para lograrlo, el programa cuenta con tres componentes centrales diseñados para: 1. Promover la descentralización y el desarrollo regional, y mejorar la transparencia y las capacidades de gestión de inversiones de las prefecturas departamentales. 2. Mejorar la capacidad de los ciudadanos para ejercer sus derechos y responsabilidades de manera efectiva, y de las organizaciones de la sociedad civil para monitorear el proceso político y liderar un debate pluralista. 3. Fortalecer la capacidad del Congreso Nacional para funcionar de manera efectiva y transparente de manera que promueva el debate pluralista.

description.narrative: The purpose of this task order will be to support technically sound administration of historic Sudanese electoral processes called for in the Comprehensive Peace Agreement (CPA) through: 1) Strengthening the capacity of election management bodies in Sudan to administer credible elections and referenda; and 2) Providing election-related commodities needed to ensure the success of these key political processes.

description.narrative: This program supports the Mission's goal for an independent, prosperous, and healthy Ukraine united around core European values in one or more of the following sectors: strengthening of democratic governance, and more inclusive, sustainable, market-driven economic growth.

Le programme Programme de Gouvernance Partage 2 (PGP2), financé par l’USAID, s’appuie sur les objectifs et les succès du projet précédent et consolide le processus de démocratisation naissant du Mali, renforce la stabilité et maintient la paix dans les régions du nord du pays. Il favorise également le développement local en garantissant que les responsables locaux sont capables de s'acquitter efficacement de leurs responsabilités. PGP2 s'appuie sur d'importants partenariats locaux pour atteindre ses objectifs. Les ONG partenaires ont été formées à la démocratie et à la gouvernance, à la création d'organisations civiques, à la formation et à la collecte de données.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

title.narrative: Feed the Future Innovation Lab for Collaborative Research on Grain Legumes (Legume Innovation Lab)
Alimentar el laboratorio de innovación del futuro para la investigación colaborativa sobre leguminosas de grano (Laboratorio de innovación de leguminosas)

description.narrative: The Feed the Future Innovation Lab for Collaborative Research on Grain Legumes (formerly the Pulse CRSP) contributes to economic growth and food and nutrition security through knowledge and technology generation that strengthens grain legume (e.g., bean, cowpea, pigeon pea, etc.) value chains and enhances the capacity and sustainability of agriculture research institutions that serve grain legume sectors in developing countries of Africa and Latin America.

El Laboratorio de Innovación Feed the Future para la investigación colaborativa sobre leguminosas de grano (anteriormente Pulse CRSP) contribuye al crecimiento económico y la seguridad alimentaria y nutricional a través de la generación de conocimiento y tecnología que fortalece las cadenas de valor de las leguminosas de grano (por ejemplo, frijol, caupí, gandul, etc.) y mejora la capacidad y la sostenibilidad de las instituciones de investigación agrícola que prestan servicios a los sectores de leguminosas de grano en los países en desarrollo de África y América Latina.

title.narrative: Agricultural Sector Productivity - Title II Farmer-to-Farmer

description.narrative: Sustain the productivity of the agricultural sector through investments that foster increasing returns to land, labor, and capital. Targeted interventions to male and female producers provide improvements in technology and management practices, expanded access to markets and credit, increased organizational and market efficiency, and restoration and protection of resiliency in production and livelihood systems.

(USAID Bureau For Food Security (BFS)): Purpose of Activity: The goal of the program is to develop wheat lines whose yield is more resistant to heat stress, which would mitigate the anticipated climate change-associated yield losses for this staple cereal, not only in the target geography-South Asia-but also improve the heat associated yields in most wheat growing regions of the world.Description of Activities for FY 14: Continued screening of germplasm and strategic crosses with those selections already made will move the germplasm component of the project toward the generation of new, heat tolerant, wheat lines. Continued selection and characterization of novel alleles of the 4 target genes will lead to candidate materials for crossing into selected germplasm. The generation of transgenic wheat, expressing an additional target, will provide another novel allele for crossing into selected germplasm.FTF Focus Countries in which Activity Works: NoneFTF Non-Focus Countries in which Activity Works: India and China

(USAID Bureau For Food Security (BFS)): Purpose: To implement the Science, Technology and Innovation elements of the Global Food Security Act, a portfolio of research programs across the biophysical and social sciences have been developed and are central to advancing novel solutions that support global efforts to reduce hunger, poverty, and malnutrition. The Virus Resistant Cassava activity is developing farmer-preferred cassava varieties resistant to cassava brown streak disease (CBSD) to improve the livelihoods of smallholder farmers living in East Africa. This activity supports U.S. economic interest as it draws on U.S. private sector expertise to address the GFSS goal of reducing global hunger, malnutrition, and poverty..Activities: In Uganda and Kenya, combined transgenic CBSD and inherent Cassava mosaic disease (CMD) resistance in progeny from conventional breeding to be confirmed in confined field trials (CFTs); selection of product lines will begin and field candidates in three new varieties will be identified and advanced to CFTs in Africa. The Regulatory Field Trials program is on track to generate regulatory-grade data for submission..... ....

The Health, Education and Reconciliation (HEAR) Sudan project, funded by USAID, operated in the most neglected and least developed parts of Sudan. Teachers were trained in basic education knowledge, child-centered teaching skills, health and hygiene, conflict resolution and service-learning. The project trained community health workers to visit schools with an integrated package of health services. To strengthen school governance, it trained PTAs, teachers and school administrators on school management, monitoring and promoting transparency and accountability.

title.narrative: South Sudan Rural Land Governance (SRLG) Project

description.narrative: Decades of civil war have destroyed many of South Sudans institutions of governance and resulted in the breakdown of systems that regulated land administration. Tetra Tech implements the USAID-funded South Sudan Rural Land Governance (SRLG) Project, which provides technical assistance to the South Sudan Land Commission (SSLC) in reforming and rebuilding South Sudans land sector. The project is increasing the capacity of the SSLC to help state and county authorities in Jonglei and Western Equatoria States develop new statutory institutions to administer land rights, govern natural resource use, foster social and political stability, and build an enabling environment for sustainable economic development.

title.narrative: EBRD Eastern European Energy Efficiency & Environmental Partnership

description.narrative: (Europe and Eurasia Regional): Clean Energy Global Climate Change Funding: In response to the United States Government's pledge to the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD)'s regional Eastern Europe Energy Efficiency and Environment Partnership (E5P) Fund, USAID is providing the E5P Fund $1.5 million in Clean Energy Global Climate Change funding for projects in Ukraine. The purpose of the Fund is to provide for the harmonized, effective delivery of international financial support for energy efficiency and environmental projects that would produce significant energy savings and reduce emissions of greenhouse gases in public buildings and infrastructure. General principles for the allocation and use of E5P resources include (a) the achievement of long-term impacts that would not otherwise be achieved with standard International Financial Institutions' instruments, (b) the use of discipline to minimize the potential for waste and distortions, and (c) the introduction of metering and control systems as well as consumption-based billing as critical elements of investment projects. BackgroundAccess to financing remains a barrier to energy efficiency projects in Eurasia. In response to the United States Government's $7.5 million pledge to the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD)'s regional E5P Fund, USAID is providing Ukraine $1.5 million annually for five years for a total planned investment of $7.5 million. The purpose of the Fund is to provide for the harmonized, effective delivery of international financial support for energy efficiency and environmental projects that would produce significant energy savings and reduce carbon dioxide and other emissions of greenhouse gases. Fund resources can be used for investment grants to support an overall financial package for energy efficient investments and technical assistance to help prepare projects and/or increase the management capacity of beneficiaries. Grants will also be used

title.narrative: Program for Biosafety Systems in Tanzania (PBS)

description.narrative: (Tanzania): The purpose of the Program for Biosafety Systems in Tanzania (PBS) activity is to improve farmers' access to agricultural biotechnology, foster private-sector investment, and encourage trade in agricultural commodities. Funding will be used to sustain legal and political engagement related to the removal of strict liability provisions present in current biosafety regulations. In addition, through the engagement and training of legal authorities, scientists, and other stakeholders, this activity will continue the revision of biotechnology research activity regulations for safe use of genetically-modified organisms plants and plant products, both on the mainland Tanzania and in Zanzibar. This work will also comprise of confined field trials and the fast-tracking of both biotechnology and biosafety regulation review processes...

title.narrative: Financial Integration, Economic Leveraging, Broad-Based Dissemination (FIELD) Leader with Associates (LWA)
Líder de Integración Financiera, Apalancamiento Económico, Difusión Amplia (FIELD) con Asociados (LWA)

description.narrative: FIELD-Support is a Leader with Associates (LWA) Cooperative Agreement between the Office of Microenterprise and Private Enterprise Development in USAID (E3/MPEP) and FHI 360. FIELD-Support encompasses both a core Leader award and a mechanism for USAID Missions to issue Associate Awards. The purpose of the Leader award is to advance the frontiers of practical knowledge in relation to microfinance, microenterprise development, and sustainable rural livelihoods, working in close collaboration with the USAID/Micro-enterprise and Private Enterprise Promotion (MPEP) Office in Washington DC, USAID Missions and Operating Units, and the broader community of development practitioners.

FIELD-Support es un acuerdo cooperativo de Líder con Asociados (LWA) entre la Oficina de Desarrollo de Microempresas y Empresas Privadas de USAID (E3/MPEP) y FHI 360. FIELD-Support abarca tanto un premio de Líder central como un mecanismo para que las Misiones de USAID emitan Premios de Asociados. El propósito del premio Leader es avanzar las fronteras del conocimiento práctico en relación con las microfinanzas, el desarrollo de microempresas y los medios de vida rurales sostenibles, trabajando en estrecha colaboración con la Oficina de USAID/Promoción de Microempresas y Empresas Privadas (MPEP) en Washington DC, las Misiones y Unidades Operativas de USAID y la comunidad más amplia de profesionales del desarrollo.

The CTI Private Financing Advisory Network (PFAN) identifies promising clean energy projects at an early stage and provides mentoring for development of a business plan, investment pitch, and growth strategy, significantly enhancing the possibility of financial closure. Over 222 clean energy projects have been inducted into the CTI PFAN Project Development Pipeline. These projects include biogas, biomass, waste to energy, clean transport, wind, solar, small hydro and energy efficiency initiatives. Successfully 44 projects have achieved financial closure with over US$540 million of investment raised. Combined, these projects have the potential to mitigate over 2 million tons of CO2e per year and provide over 346 MW of Clean Generation Capacity. To get involved in CTI PFAN, pleasecontactour country and regional offices or join us at one of the Clean Energy FinancingForums.

A Rede Consultiva de Financiamento Privado da CTI (PFAN) identifica projetos promissores de energia limpa numa fase inicial e fornece orientação para o desenvolvimento de um plano de negócios, proposta de investimento e estratégia de crescimento, aumentando significativamente a possibilidade de encerramento financeiro. Mais de 222 projetos de energia limpa foram incluídos no pipeline de desenvolvimento de projetos do CTI PFAN. Esses projetos incluem iniciativas de biogás, biomassa, transformação de resíduos em energia, transporte limpo, energia eólica, solar, pequenas hidrelétricas e eficiência energética. 44 projetos alcançaram o encerramento financeiro com sucesso, com mais de 540 milhões de dólares em investimentos arrecadados. Combinados, estes projetos têm o potencial de mitigar mais de 2 milhões de toneladas de CO2e por ano e fornecer mais de 346 MW de capacidade de geração limpa. Para se envolver no CTI PFAN, entre em contato com nossos escritórios nacionais e regionais ou junte-se a nós em um dos Fóruns de Financiamento de Energia Limpa.

(USAID Economic Growth, Education and Environment (E3)): The International Trade Centre (ITC) was established by the WTO and the UNCTAD to promote the ability of developing country businesses to successfully export by providing appropriate tools for trade development to the private sector, trade support institutions and policy-makers. These tools focus on access to trade data and training in trade data analysis.~The ITC supports businesses in developing countries to become more competitive in global markets, speeding economic development and contributing to the achievement of the United Nations' sustainable Development Goals. Current activities specifically focus on addressing non-tariff barriers to trade in the Middle East region.~This activity helps E3's overall objective of promoting economic growth through the implementation of trade and investment promotion activities and technical training.

title.narrative: Scaling up the Safe Schools Program Through Peace Corps
Ampliando o Programa Escolas Seguras por meio do Peace Corps

description.narrative: E3/GENDEV will provide an additional $500,000 to the Peace Corps to carry out the "Promoting Gender across Peace Corps Sectors-Safe Schools III Activity." Funds will support: (1) missions to conduct gender-related trainings and technical assistance with volunteers and work partners, including the implementation of training packages developed under the Safe Schools program. Funds associated with this Statement of Work (SOW) will be used to deliver TOTs ("Training Other Teachers") through a regional roll-out conference of about 5 countries, and in-service trainings on the "Creating an Enabling Environment" training package and an additional training packages being developed. Teachers demonstrate skills to better manage their classrooms (for example, positive discipline techniques, equitable treatment of male and female students, adherence to professional standards and teacher codes of conduct), and to create a higher quality learning environment. This activity scales up a successful evidence-based E3 funded project, "The Safe Schools Program", thereby demonstrating technical leadership in this area. The activity will provide technical training to Peace Corps Volunteers and host country teachers to create a positive learning environment for students. This cooperation between the Peace Corps and USAID supports an 'Education Strategy' by creating higher quality learning environments for students. The "Progress in International Reading Literacy Study (PIRLS) 2006" Report, also confirms that a safe and secure school environment is a positive learning environment.

E3/GENDEV fornecerá US$ 500.000 adicionais ao Corpo da Paz para realizar a Atividade III de "Promoção do Gênero nos Setores do Corpo da Paz - Escolas Seguras III". Os fundos apoiarão: (1) missões para realizar formações relacionadas com o género e assistência técnica com voluntários e parceiros de trabalho, incluindo a implementação de pacotes de formação desenvolvidos no âmbito do programa Escolas Seguras. Os fundos associados a esta Declaração de Trabalho (SOW) serão utilizados para fornecer TOTs ("Formação de Outros Professores") através de uma conferência regional de implementação de cerca de 5 países, e formações em serviço sobre o pacote de formação "Criar um Ambiente Favorável" e pacotes de formação adicionais que estão a ser desenvolvidos. Os professores demonstram competências para gerir melhor as suas salas de aula (por exemplo, técnicas de disciplina positiva, tratamento equitativo de alunos do sexo masculino e feminino, adesão a padrões profissionais e códigos de conduta dos professores) e para criar um ambiente de aprendizagem de maior qualidade. Esta actividade amplia um projecto bem sucedido financiado pela E3, baseado em evidências, "O Programa Escolas Seguras", demonstrando assim liderança técnica nesta área. A actividade proporcionará formação técnica aos Voluntários do Corpo da Paz e aos professores do país anfitrião para criar um ambiente de aprendizagem positivo para os alunos. Esta cooperação entre o Peace Corps e a USAID apoia uma “Estratégia Educacional”, criando ambientes de aprendizagem de maior qualidade para os alunos. O Relatório "Progress in International Reading Literacy Study (PIRLS) 2006" também confirma que um ambiente escolar seguro e protegido é um ambiente de aprendizagem positivo.

title.narrative: Programme L'éducation ne peut pas attendre
Programme L'éducation ne peut pas attendre

description.narrative: Education Cannot Wait (ECW) will transform the delivery of education in emergencies - one that joins up governments, humanitarian actors and development efforts to deliver a more collaborative and rapid response to the educational needs of children and youth affected by crises. ECW provides support through the Breakthrough Fund to channel financial support to those who are active in-country and support and mechanisms through the Acceleration Facility designed to support global and regional actors for the development of global goods and other joint activities.
Banque mondiale Doing Business II

Education Cannot Wait (ECW) transformera la prestation de l'éducation dans les situations d'urgence - une prestation qui réunira les gouvernements, les acteurs humanitaires et les efforts de développement pour apporter une réponse plus collaborative et plus rapide aux besoins éducatifs des enfants et des jeunes touchés par les crises. ECW fournit un soutien via le Breakthrough Fund pour canaliser le soutien financier vers ceux qui sont actifs dans le pays et un soutien et des mécanismes via le Fonds d'accélération conçu pour soutenir les acteurs mondiaux et régionaux pour le développement de biens mondiaux et d'autres activités conjointes.

title.narrative: Wildlife Trafficking Response, Assessment, and Priority Setting (Wildlife-TRAPS)

description.narrative: The Wildlife Trafficking Response, Assessment and Priority Setting (Wildlife TRAPS) Program will protect global biodiversity through strengthening the knowledge base and cooperation of governments, inter-governmental organizations, the private sector, and non-governmental organizations to tackle illegal wildlife trade between the two continents. Poaching of elephants and rhinos is presently at record levels in Africa, with the ivory and rhino horn destined for Asia. The criminal networks behind the smuggling have been linked to human trafficking, arms and narcotics networks.

title.narrative: Gender Equality for Climate Change Opportunities (GECCO)

description.narrative: The Gender Equality for Climate Change Opportunities (GECCO) project aims to enable women's leadership in climate change mitigation and adaptation through three streams of activities: 1) Development of climate change gender action plans (ccGAPs) in countries of overlapping high priority for USAID's gender and climate change and development objectives and host-government interests; 2) Implementation of activities that contribute to meeting national objectives of advancing gender equality through and for improved outcomes from climate change and development initiatives. These activities will support the mutual objectives of USAID missions and host-governments; and 3) Convening of donor platforms at the national level to coordinate collaboration on ccGAP implementation for the purpose of increasing women's leadership in climate related sectors. This activity will contribute to E3/GenDev's technical leadership on gender integration in climate change and development initiatives. This activity will contribute to formulating USAID development goals by providing support to missions in reducing gender-equality gaps relevant to climate change and development projects with the aim of also increasing the effectiveness of missions in achieving climate change objectives.

title.narrative: Strengthening Domestic Revenue Mobilization, Budgeting and Financial Accountability, Government Debt and Infrastructure Finance, and Banking and Financial Services

description.narrative: This mechanism allows USAID operating units to obtain technical assistance from the U.S. Treasury to improve domestic revenue collection, budgeting and financial accountability, government debt management and infrastructure finance, and banking and financial services in partner countries. Helping partner countries to generate their own resources for development and spend them efficiently reduces poverty, unemployment, and economic instability. This improves trust in the country's government and, coupled with U.S. Treasury's ability to respond to debt, budgetary, and financial crises, addresses the conditions that give rise to extremism. The accountable and streamlined management of domestic resources also minimizes opportunities for corruption; levels the playing field for U.S. businesses abroad; and helps ensure that foreign aid is spent as intended. Improvement in economic conditions also generates demand for U.S. exports in the many sectors where the U.S. has comparative advantage.

title.narrative: Programme de développement du droit commercial (CLDP) IAA
Programme de développement du droit commercial (CLDP) IAA

description.narrative: (USAID Economic Growth, Education and Environment (E3)): The Office of Trade and Regulatory Reform (E3/TRR) maintains a global Participating Agency Program Agreement (PAPA) with the Commercial Law Development Program of the U.S. Department of Commerce. CLDP runs programs bringing U.S. Government experts and private sector consultants to both reform and to build capacity on commercial law and trade policies. These programs help create sound business enabling environments, promoting trade and investment opportunities for both US and foreign firms. The PAPA is a flexible instrument enabling field missions, regional bureaus, and the State Department to buy-in to the PAPA agreement on a demand-driven basis.

Education Cannot Wait (ECW) transformera la prestation de l'éducation dans les situations d'urgence - une prestation qui réunira les gouvernements, les acteurs humanitaires et les efforts de développement pour apporter une réponse plus collaborative et plus rapide aux besoins éducatifs des enfants et des jeunes touchés par les crises. ECW fournit un soutien via le Breakthrough Fund pour canaliser le soutien financier vers ceux qui sont actifs dans le pays et un soutien et des mécanismes via le Fonds d'accélération conçu pour soutenir les acteurs mondiaux et régionaux pour le développement de biens mondiaux et d'autres activités conjointes.

(Croissance économique, éducation et environnement de l'USAID (E3)) : Le Bureau du commerce et de la réforme de la réglementation (E3/TRR) maintient un accord mondial de programme d'agence participante (PAPA) avec le programme de développement du droit commercial du ministère du Commerce des États-Unis. Le CLDP gère des programmes réunissant des experts du gouvernement américain et des consultants du secteur privé pour réformer et renforcer les capacités en matière de droit commercial et de politiques commerciales. Ces programmes contribuent à créer des environnements commerciaux sains et favorables, en favorisant les opportunités de commerce et d'investissement pour les entreprises américaines et étrangères. Le PAPA est un instrument flexible permettant aux missions sur le terrain, aux bureaux régionaux et au Département d'État d'adhérer à l'accord PAPA en fonction de la demande.

description.narrative: Then Customs and Border Protection will assist Vietnam Customs in developing technical tools, systems and processes, and internal procedures for monitoring and measuring trade compliance. Improved performance in these areas will help Vietnam fulfill its obligations under the World Trade Organization's Trade Facilitation Agreement, meet its ASEAN commitments and prepare the country for additional obligations likely to stem from the Trans-Pacific Partnership Agreement (TPP). The USAID/GIG is also supporting a private sector led alliance, led by the American Chamber of Commerce in Vietnam interested in engaging on trade facilitation reform. Another area of potential collaboration beyond the current activities is in the area of combatting illegal trade, specifically as it applies to combatting wildlife trafficking (a key provision of the TPP environment chapter).

(Croissance économique, éducation et environnement de l'USAID (E3)) : Le Bureau du commerce et de la réforme de la réglementation (E3/TRR) maintient un accord mondial de programme d'agence participante (PAPA) avec le programme de développement du droit commercial du ministère du Commerce des États-Unis. Le CLDP gère des programmes réunissant des experts du gouvernement américain et des consultants du secteur privé pour réformer et renforcer les capacités en matière de droit commercial et de politiques commerciales. Ces programmes contribuent à créer des environnements commerciaux sains et favorables, en favorisant les opportunités de commerce et d'investissement pour les entreprises américaines et étrangères. Le PAPA est un instrument flexible permettant aux missions sur le terrain, aux bureaux régionaux et au Département d'État d'adhérer à l'accord PAPA en fonction de la demande.

description.narrative: (International Fund for Ireland): .As part of the United States' efforts to secure a permanent, durable political settlement in Northern Ireland, USAID provides support to the International Fund for Ireland (IFI), which promotes economic and social advancement, and encourages contact between nationalists and unionists throughout Northern Ireland and the border counties of Ireland in an effort to reduce violence and build the foundations for peaceful coexistence. FY 2021 funds will support activities such as cross-community workshops on violence prevention and job training for unemployed youth in communities with the highest rates of joblessness and sectarian violence. This will support the United States' goal, and the goals of the U.S. government's British and Irish partners, that IFI assistance be targeted toward those communities that have not realized the benefits of the peace process...In addition, the uncertainties and challenges introduced by Brexit and COVID will be detrimental to the impoverished and marginalized communities the projects historically target. Assistance will be needed during this difficult period for Northern Ireland and to cement the hard earned gains from decades of United States engagement in the peace process..The implementing partner is the IFI.

description.narrative: USAID and The Coca-Cola Company (TCCC) will provide funding to the Water and Development Alliance (WADA) for pilot programming to reduce non-revenue water (NRW). USAID will support WADA to work directly with a water utility and coordinate with the holding company to identify key zones for intervention and build upon existing training and technical work. NRW reduction activities include: measuring water flow, leak detection and repair, installing and fixing meters, reducing illegal connections, and increasing billing and collections. Public outreach activities will be conducted through TCCC's existing partners and will focus on consumer awareness related to metering, illegal connections, and demand management. Programming will also highlight benefits arising from community participation in water management. Expected results will be increased customer satisfaction due to improved service delivery, improved understanding of costs associated with water service delivery, and a higher acceptance of metering and a concomitant increase in bills paid.

title.narrative: Mejora de las regulaciones de servicios públicos sostenibles (ENSURE)

description.narrative: Enhancing Sustainable Utility Regulation (ENSURE) is a Cooperative Agreement withthe United States Agency for International Development.Theprogram creates a means and structure whereby regulators from the developing world can discuss mutual challenges and examine best practices with their counterparts from the U.S.The ENSURE program encompasses a variety of bilateral partnerships, workshops, training, capacity building and other technical development activities to assist regulators from around the world to develop stronger regulatory practices and advance economic development. This NARUC/USAID Cooperative Agreement serves the international regulatory community by offering the ability to interact with counterparts through information and peer-to-peer exchanges between regulatory bodies and associations from around the world and across multiple sectors: energy, water, and telecommunications. In addition to covering basic regulatory principles, NARUC also addresses timely issues such as renewable energy, energy efficiency, and climate change. As the U.S. boasts a history of multi-sector regulators, NARUC's members are ideally suited to discuss complex regulatory practices with foreign regulators from each of the utility sectors.

Mejorar la Regulación Sostenible de Servicios Públicos (ENSURE) es un acuerdo de cooperación con la Agencia de los Estados Unidos para el Desarrollo Internacional. El programa crea un medio y una estructura mediante los cuales los reguladores del mundo en desarrollo pueden discutir desafíos mutuos y examinar las mejores prácticas con sus contrapartes de los EE. UU. El programa ENSURE abarca una variedad de asociaciones bilaterales, talleres, capacitación, desarrollo de capacidades y otras actividades de desarrollo técnico para ayudar a los reguladores de todo el mundo a desarrollar prácticas regulatorias más sólidas y promover el desarrollo económico. Este Acuerdo de Cooperación NARUC/USAID sirve a la comunidad regulatoria internacional al ofrecer la capacidad de interactuar con contrapartes a través de información e intercambios entre pares entre organismos reguladores y asociaciones de todo el mundo y en múltiples sectores: energía, agua y telecomunicaciones. Además de cubrir los principios regulatorios básicos, NARUC también aborda temas actuales como la energía renovable, la eficiencia energética y el cambio climático. Como Estados Unidos cuenta con una historia de reguladores multisectoriales, los miembros de NARUC son ideales para discutir prácticas regulatorias complejas con reguladores extranjeros de cada uno de los sectores de servicios públicos.

Alimentar el Futuro Laboratorio de Innovación para la Investigación Colaborativa en Horticultura -MasRiego

description.narrative: Feed the Future Partnering for Innovation~will support the Mission in developing Public Private Partnerships to identify and scale-up viable agricultural technologies, support investment in emerging horticulture makets, and strengthen business models to contribute to increases in incomes for smallholder farmers.~ The mechanism will help build profitable, sustainable businesses by investing in them to launch effective agricultural technologies and will~spur private sector investment to disseminate those technologies to smallholders, especially women, in Guatemala. ~This field support buy-in will work with two private businesses through Public Private Partnerships to increase their activities in the FTF ZOI: (1) Asociacion Popoy, will be marketing beneficial organisms for integrate pest management in horticulture value chains in the Western Highlands; (2) Unispice will work with farmers to increase brussel sprout production and decrease the rejection rate.

L'activité principale du programme de partenariat pour les services publics de l'énergie est l'établissement de partenariats exécutifs individuels entre les services publics d'électricité des pays en développement, les services publics de gaz, les opérateurs de transport et d'autres opérateurs et décideurs politiques du secteur énergétique et leurs homologues américains.

Feed the Future Partnering for Innovation ~ soutiendra la mission dans le développement de partenariats public-privé pour identifier et développer des technologies agricoles viables, soutenir les investissements dans les marchés horticoles émergents et renforcer les modèles commerciaux pour contribuer à l'augmentation des revenus des petits exploitants agricoles. ~Ce soutien sur le terrain travaillera avec deux entreprises privées par le biais de partenariats public-privé pour accroître leurs activités dans la ZOI FTF : (1) l'Asociación Popoy commercialisera des organismes bénéfiques pour intégrer la lutte antiparasitaire dans les chaînes de valeur horticoles dans les hauts plateaux de l'ouest ; (2) Unispice travaillera avec les agriculteurs pour augmenter la production de choux de Bruxelles et réduire le taux de rejet.

Feed the Future Partnering for Innovation apoyará la Misión en el desarrollo de asociaciones público-privadas para identificar y ampliar tecnologías agrícolas viables, apoyar la inversión en mercados hortícolas emergentes y fortalecer los modelos de negocios para contribuir a aumentar los ingresos de los pequeños agricultores. El mecanismo ayudará a construir negocios rentables y sostenibles invirtiendo en ellos para lanzar tecnologías agrícolas efectivas y estimulará la inversión del sector privado para difundir esas tecnologías entre los pequeños agricultores, especialmente las mujeres, en Guatemala. ~Esta compra de apoyo de campo trabajará con dos empresas privadas a través de asociaciones público-privadas para aumentar sus actividades en la ZOI del FTF: (1) Asociación Popoy, comercializará organismos benéficos para el manejo integrado de plagas en las cadenas de valor de la horticultura en las tierras altas occidentales; (2) Unispice trabajará con los agricultores para aumentar la producción de coles de Bruselas y disminuir la tasa de rechazo.

title.narrative: Water Access, Sanitation and Hygiene for the Urban Poor (WASH-UP)

description.narrative: (USAID West Africa Regional): With FY 2014 funding, the Water Access, Sanitation and Hygiene for the Urban Poor (WASH-UP) project aims to increase household access to drinking water supply by continuing to expand improved water supply to communities and households through individual house connections and public water points. In addition, WASH-UP will focus on increasing access to sanitation with particular attention on "improved sanitation" which puts premium on individual latrine facilities than communal facilities for health and management reasons. The project will promote innovative and cost-effective water and sanitation enterprises. It will achieve this by supporting and establishing small-scale private enterprises engaged in innovative water and sanitation activities. WASH-UP will continue to implement behavior change communication campaigns directed towards addressing specific barriers to the adoption of proper and desirable sanitation, hygiene and water consumption behaviors.
